SV-WAM: An Efficient Surround-View World-Action Model for End-to-End Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

surround-view world-action model end-to-end autonomous driving action-centered causal mask drivable-area compliance regularizer

简要说明：SV-WAM提出了一种用于端到端自动驾驶的环视世界-动作模型，利用未来视频预测作为动作学习的训练监督，在部署时仅保留动作分支以消除视频生成，实现低延迟和高规划性能。

TLDR: SV-WAM proposes a surround-view world-action model for end-to-end autonomous driving that uses future-video prediction as training supervision for action learning, enabling deployment with only action tokens and eliminating video generation at inference for low latency and high planning performance.

Abstract: World models (WMs) have demonstrated strong potential for end-to-end autonomous driving by learning predictive representations of future scene dynamics. However, generating future videos during inference introduces substantial computational overhead, leading many recent driving WMs to adopt a single front camera as input for efficient deployment. This design restricts spatial coverage in safety-critical maneuvers such as lane changes, merges, and turns. To address this limitation, we propose SV-WAM, a surround-view world-action model (WAM) that preserves full six-camera observations while maintaining efficient inference. SV-WAM leverages future-video prediction as dense training supervision for action learning within a shared generative model, rather than as an inference-time output. At the core of this design is an action-centered causal mask that prevents action tokens from attending to future-video tokens during joint action-video denoising. Consequently, the video branch can be discarded at deployment, enabling efficient action-only planning. Furthermore, we introduce a differentiable drivable-area compliance regularizer that penalizes vehicle-footprint corners approaching or crossing drivable boundaries, improving planning safety and boundary awareness. Extensive experiments on the closed-loop NAVSIMv2 benchmark and the open-loop nuScenes benchmark demonstrate that SV-WAM achieves state-of-the-art planning performance with low inference latency and competitive zero-shot transfer capability.

摘要（中文）：世界模型通过学习未来场景动态的预测表征，在端到端自动驾驶领域展现出强大潜力。然而，推理阶段生成未来视频会带来显著计算开销，导致近期许多驾驶世界模型采用单前视摄像头作为输入以实现高效部署。这种设计在换道、并线及转弯等安全关键操作中限制了空间覆盖范围。为解决该局限性，我们提出SV-WAM——一种环视世界-动作模型，其在保持高效推理的同时保留了完整六摄像头观测信息。SV-WAM将未来视频预测作为共享生成模型中动作学习的密集训练监督信号，而非推理阶段的输出。该设计的核心是基于动作中心化的因果掩码机制，该机制在联合动作-视频去噪过程中阻止动作令牌关注未来视频令牌。因此，部署时可弃用视频分支，实现仅基于动作的高效规划。此外，我们引入可微分的可行驶区域合规正则化项，对接近或跨越可行驶边界的车辆足迹角点施加惩罚，从而提升规划安全性与边界感知能力。在闭环NAVSIMv2基准与开环nuScenes基准上的大量实验表明，SV-WAM以低推理延迟和强零样本迁移能力实现了最先进的规划性能。

Authors: Jinyang Wang, Shiwei Li, Junjian Wang, Zhiqiang Deng, Jianbin Gao, Yihang Zhao, Liu Liu, Yongjia Zhao, Jinlong Chen, Huirui Xu, Yifeng Pan, Kangwei Liu, Fan Ren, Ji Tao, Minghao Yang

Scaling Bimanual Household Manipulation from 1,500 hours of Demonstrations to On-Policy Corrections VLA

bimanual manipulation vision-language-action scaling demonstrations DAgger corrections robot foundation model

简要说明：本文发布了1500小时的双臂家务操作大规模数据集，并训练了VLA模型（XR-2），该模型在增加演示和纠正数据时展现出持续的缩放改进，支持通用双臂操作策略。

TLDR: This paper releases a large-scale dataset of 1,500 hours of bimanual household manipulations and trains a VLA model (XR-2) that shows consistent scaling improvements with more demonstration and correction data, supporting generalist bimanual manipulation policies.

Abstract: Learning generalist policies for robust bimanual manipulation is bottlenecked by the scarcity of high quality large scale human demonstration data. In this work, we release 1,500 hours of diverse bimanual manipulation demonstrations covering everyday household tasks, and use this comprehensive corpus to train XR-2, a powerful vision-language-action (VLA) model. Enabled by a purpose built high throughput data pipeline and a carefully designed multi stage training paradigm, XR-2 attains strong manipulation performance in our systematic experiments while retaining favorable training efficiency and high data utilization. We further study two critical scaling axes: varying the amount of expert demonstration data, and post training on DAgger correction data from real time human interventions. In both settings, task success rate improves steadily over the data ranges we probe, exhibiting a clear consistent scaling trend at our current data scale. These results validate both the learning capacity of XR-2 and the promising scaling properties of the released dataset, which we open source to support reproducible research on bimanual robot manipulation learning.

摘要（中文）：学习通用策略以实现鲁棒的双臂操作，其瓶颈在于高质量大规模人类示教数据的稀缺。在本工作中，我们发布了涵盖日常家务任务的1500小时多样化双臂操作示教数据，并利用这一综合性语料库训练了XR-2——一个强大的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型。通过专用的高通量数据流水线及精心设计的多阶段训练范式，XR-2在系统实验中展现出了强大的操作性能，同时保持了良好的训练效率与高数据利用率。我们进一步研究了两个关键的扩展维度：专家示教数据量的变化，以及基于实时人类干预的DAgger校正数据上的后训练。在这两种设定下，任务成功率在所探索的数据范围内均稳步提升，在当前数据规模下呈现出清晰一致的可扩展趋势。这些结果验证了XR-2的学习能力，也证实了所发布数据集具有令人期待的可扩展特性，我们将该数据集开源，以支持双臂机器人操作学习的可重复研究。

Authors: Jiafeng Xu, Qi Li, Yan Shen, Yiyu Ren, Travis Davies, Shaowen He, Ze Wang, Yifan Yang, Ran Cheng, Hao Dong

Sensing Which Modality Matters: Evidence-Gated Regularization for Robust VLA Policies VLA

modality entanglement evidence-gated regularization robust VLA policies consistency objectives sensor task-relevance

简要说明：提出证据门控正则化（EGR）以减少VLA策略中的模态纠缠，在传感器损坏和单传感器故障下提升鲁棒性，在BEHAVIOR-1K和两个真实机器人平台上验证。

TLDR: Proposes Evidence-Gated Regularization (EGR) to reduce modality entanglement in VLA policies, improving robustness under sensor corruption and single-sensor fallback, validated on BEHAVIOR-1K and two real robot setups.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies fuse multimodal sensory inputs, but training on limited and homogeneous robot demonstrations encourages spurious inter-sensor correlations rather than task-relevant signal, a failure we term modality entanglement. Under real-world occlusions and distractors, this manifests as nuisance sensitivity to corruption of uninformative sensors and single-modality insufficiency when only one informative sensor remains intact. We propose Evidence-Gated Regularization (EGR), a modality-agnostic training objective that introduces zero inference-time overhead. EGR derives a per-frame and per-sensor task-relevance signal to gate two state-conditional consistency objectives: invariance on low-evidence sensors, and single-sensor sufficiency on high-evidence ones. We introduce a benchmark based on BEHAVIOR-1K, comprising a fast inference-only diagnostic suite and 47 rollout-based skills targeting modality entanglement. We validate EGR on this benchmark and on two real-robot setups with fundamentally different embodiments: a bi-manual setup with two Kinova arms and three RGB cameras, and a single-arm MELFA ASSISTA setup combining vision and GelSight tactile sensors. EGR improves simulation success rates (SR) from 12.5% to 16.4% under full modalities (+31%), from 9.4% to 16.5% under uninformative-sensor corruption (+75%), and from 2.8% to 6.1% under single-sensor fallback (+120%). Under physical-object distractors, EGR boosts SR from 30% to 85% on the bi-manual setup (+183%) and from 55% to 70% on the tactile setup (+27%).

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略融合了多模态感知输入，但在有限且同质化的机器人演示数据上进行训练会鼓励传感器间产生虚假关联，而非任务相关信号——我们将这种缺陷称为模态纠缠。在现实世界的遮挡和干扰条件下，这种缺陷表现为对无信息传感器的损坏具有干扰敏感性，以及当仅剩一个信息传感器完好时出现单模态能力不足。我们提出证据门控正则化（EGR），这是一种与模态无关的训练目标，且不增加任何推理阶段的计算开销。EGR 推导出每帧、每传感器的任务相关性信号，用于门控两种状态条件一致性目标：低证据传感器上的不变性，以及高证据传感器上的单传感器充分性。我们基于 BEHAVIOR-1K 构建了一个基准测试，包含一个仅需推理的快速诊断套件和 47 个针对模态纠缠的 rollout 技能。我们在该基准测试以及两个具备根本不同本体结构的真实机器人平台上验证了 EGR：一个配备两台 Kinova 机械臂和三台 RGB 摄像头的双臂平台，以及一个结合视觉和 GelSight 触觉传感器的单臂 MELFA ASSISTA 平台。EGR 将仿真成功率（SR）在全模态下从 12.5% 提升至 16.4%（+31%），在无信息传感器损坏下从 9.4% 提升至 16.5%（+75%），在单传感器回退下从 2.8% 提升至 6.1%（+120%）。在真实物体干扰下，EGR 将双臂平台的 SR 从 30% 提升至 85%（+183%），将触觉平台的 SR 从 55% 提升至 70%（+27%）。

Authors: Yue Yang, Diego Romeres, Chiori Hori, Gedas Bertasius, Daniel Szafir, Siddarth Jain

GIFT: Guided Intermediate Feature Training via Action-Oriented Structural Supervision for Robotic Manipulation Manipulation

action-sufficiency gap intermediate feature training geometry alignment affordance prediction goal-region reconstruction

简要说明：GIFT提出了一种框架，通过引导中间特征保留几何、可供性和目标结构，弥合了机器人操作中VLA和世界动作模型的行动充分性差距。

TLDR: GIFT introduces a framework that guides intermediate visual features to preserve geometry, affordance, and goal structure, bridging the action-sufficiency gap in VLA and world-action models for robotic manipulation.

Abstract: Vision-language pre-training and predictive world modeling provide robot policies with rich semantic and dynamic visual features, but their native action and visual-prediction objectives may omit critical physical and task structure while retaining control-irrelevant visual redundancy. We call this mismatch between visual richness and control utility the action-sufficiency gap. We investigate whether this gap can be bridged by guiding intermediate features to preserve three control-relevant structure in robotic manipulation: geometry governing motion feasibility, affordance encoding instruction-relevant entities, and goals grounding instructions in task-relevant regions. To this end, we present GIFT (Guided Intermediate Feature Training), an architecture-flexible framework for learning intermediate features that translates these structures into training-time constraints through geometry alignment, affordance prediction, and goal-region reconstruction. We instantiate GIFT in a Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policy, a direct-action World-Action Model (WAM), and an inverse-dynamics WAM while retaining each model's action formulation. Under zero-shot transfer to LIBERO-Plus, GIFT-VLA, GIFT-WAM-Fast, and GIFT-WAM-IDM outperform StarVLA-OFT, Fast-WAM, and Fast-WAM-IDM by 4.6, 12.6, and 5.2 points, reaching 79.6%, 72.6%, and 87.8%, respectively. On RoboCasa, the three GIFT variants reach 61.4%, 83.6%, and 82.3%, outperforming their counterparts by 12.6, 9.0, and 8.4 points, respectively. Together, these results establish learning functionally structured intermediate features as a reusable principle across model-specific action formulations, with especially large gains on articulated-object tasks and high-precision real-world manipulation under unseen visual and spatial perturbations. Project page: https://openphoenix-team.github.io/GIFT-pages.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言预训练与预测性世界模型为机器人策略提供了丰富的语义和动态视觉特征，但其原生的动作和视觉预测目标可能会忽略关键的物理与任务结构，同时保留与控制无关的视觉冗余。我们将这种视觉丰富性与控制效用之间的不匹配称为“动作充分性鸿沟”。我们探究能否通过引导中间特征保留机器人操作中三种与控制相关的结构来弥合这一鸿沟：控制运动可行性的几何结构、编码指令相关实体的可供性结构，以及将指令锚定于任务相关区域的目标结构。为此，我们提出GIFT（引导式中间特征训练），这是一种架构灵活的中间特征学习框架，通过几何对齐、可供性预测和目标区域重建，将这些结构转化为训练时的约束条件。我们在视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略、直接动作的世界-动作模型（WAM）以及逆动力学WAM中分别实例化GIFT，同时保留各模型原有的动作形式。在零样本迁移至LIBERO-Plus的实验中，GIFT-VLA、GIFT-WAM-Fast和GIFT-WAM-IDM分别达到79.6%、72.6%和87.8%，超越StarVLA-OFT、Fast-WAM和Fast-WAM-IDM 4.6、12.6和5.2个点。在RoboCasa上，三种GIFT变体分别达到61.4%、83.6%和82.3%，超越对应基线12.6、9.0和8.4个点。这些结果共同表明，学习功能结构化的中间特征可作为跨模型特定动作形式的可复用原则，尤其在铰接物体任务以及面对未见视觉与空间扰动的高精度真实世界操作中展现出显著优势。项目页面：https://openphoenix-team.github.io/GIFT-pages。

Authors: Yupeng Zheng, Xiang Li, Songen Gu, Yuhang Zheng, Shuai Tian, Weize Li, Linbo Wang, Chaoyue Li, Qichao Zhang, Haoran Li, Zhongpu Xia, Ya-Qin Zhang, Shuicheng Yan, Dongbin Zhao

A Low-Cost, Open Platform for End-to-End Autonomous Driving on a Miniature Ackermann Vehicle AutonomousDriving

end-to-end autonomous driving miniature Ackermann vehicle behavior cloning sim-to-real transfer digital twin

简要说明：本文介绍了一个用于微型阿克曼车辆端到端自动驾驶的低成本开放平台，包括实体车辆、印刷轨道、数据工具和Webots数字孪生，并建立了命令条件行为克隆基线及仿真到现实的迁移。

TLDR: This paper presents a low-cost, open platform for end-to-end autonomous driving on miniature Ackermann vehicles, including a physical vehicle, printed track, data tools, and a Webots digital twin, and establishes a command-conditioned behavior cloning baseline with sim-to-real transfer.

Abstract: This paper presents a low-cost, open experimental platform for research in end-to-end autonomous driving with miniature Ackermann vehicles. The platform combines a physical vehicle, a printed urban track, data collection tools, trajectory registration, and a Webots digital twin, enabling controlled experiments that connect simulation-based autonomous-driving methods to real-world execution. As a first baseline, we implement command-conditioned behavior cloning, in which a neural policy receives an on-board camera image and a high-level navigation command and outputs steering and speed. The system is evaluated both on the physical vehicle and in simulation. In real closed-loop experiments, the learned policy follows lanes and executes commanded turns, reaching a mean cross-track error of 6.1 cm with respect to the reference route, close to the 4.7 cm observed in human demonstrations. In the digital twin, camera field of view has a strong effect on performance, reducing the mean cross-track error from 35.6 to 3.3 cm when widened from 58 to 120 degrees. Using the digital twin to generate synthetic driving data and a learned sim-to-real image translator to reduce the appearance gap, we further show that a higher-capacity policy trained on this synthetic data combined with real demonstrations is the only configuration that completes all four track routes in closed loop, whereas the compact baseline and the same network trained on real data alone complete fewer. These results establish the open platform as a practical testbed for sim-to-real studies and provide an initial command-conditioned imitation-learning baseline; we release it to support reproducible research.

摘要（中文）：本文介绍了一种用于微型阿克曼车辆端到端自动驾驶研究的低成本开放式实验平台。该平台集成了实体车辆、印刷城市赛道、数据采集工具、轨迹注册系统以及Webots数字孪生环境，能够实现基于仿真的自动驾驶方法与实际执行之间的受控实验衔接。作为基础基准，我们实现了指令条件行为克隆方法——神经网络策略接收车载摄像头图像与高层导航指令，输出转向与速度控制信号。该系统的评估同时在实体车辆与仿真环境中进行。在实际闭环实验中，学习策略能够完成车道保持并执行指令转弯，相对参考路径的横向平均误差为6.1厘米，接近人类演示中观测到的4.7厘米。在数字孪生环境中，摄像头视场角对性能影响显著：当视场角从58度扩展至120度时，横向平均误差从35.6厘米降至3.3厘米。通过利用数字孪生生成合成驾驶数据并采用学习型仿真-真实图像转换器缩小外观差异，我们进一步证明：仅使用合成数据结合真实演示训练的高容量策略，能够在闭环条件下完成全部四条赛道线路，而紧凑型基准模型及仅使用真实数据训练的相同网络则完成较少路线。这些结果表明该开放平台可作为仿真到真实研究的实用测试平台，并提供了初始的指令条件模仿学习基线；我们公开该平台以支持可复现研究。

Authors: Gustavo Claudio Karl Couto, Eric Aislan Antonelo, Gabriel George Zipperer

Continuous Actions from Discrete Minds: Latent-Aligned Planning for End-to-End Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

Vision-Language-Action latent-aligned planning VQ-VAE action tokenizer end-to-end autonomous driving nuScenes

简要说明：LaPla 提出了一种面向端到端自动驾驶的潜对齐规划框架，通过 VQ-VAE 动作分词器和连续潜投影将离散 VLM 推理与连续车辆控制桥接，在 nuScenes 和 AlpaSim 上实现了更低的 L2 误差和更高的成功率。

TLDR: LaPla introduces a latent-aligned planning framework for end-to-end autonomous driving that uses a VQ-VAE action tokenizer and continuous latent projection to bridge discrete VLM reasoning with continuous vehicle control, achieving improved L2 error and success rate on nuScenes and AlpaSim.

Abstract: Bridging the gap between the discrete reasoning of Vision-Language Models and the continuous, physics-constrained nature of autonomous driving remains a significant challenge. In this work, we introduce LaPla, a unified Vision-Language-Action (VLA) framework featuring latent-aligned planning to seamlessly ground semantic understanding in precise motion execution. We first design an action tokenizer based on a residual vector-quantized variational autoencoder (VQ-VAE), capturing vehicle kinematics and encoding trajectory features into a structured latent space. Rather than discrete codebook lookups that inevitably introduce quantization errors, LaPla repurposes this representation as a physical prior to bridge the modality gap between high-dimensional semantics and the raw action space. Specifically, given multimodal inputs integrating multi-view images, historical actions, and textual instructions, LaPla incorporates concurrent action queries to causally attend to the multimodal context in a single forward pass, projecting hidden states directly into the pretrained VQ-VAE latent space. The frozen decoder then translates these continuous latents into actions, effectively eliminating quantization errors and ensuring physically plausible trajectories while bypassing time-consuming autoregressive generation. Extensive experiments on the nuScenes benchmark demonstrate that LaPla achieves competitive open-loop performance, reducing long-horizon L2 error by 15.52% compared to state-of-the-art VLA methods. Closed-loop evaluations on the NVIDIA AlpaSim simulator further confirm its superior capability in ensuring smooth driving progress, improving the success rate by 33.34 percentage points with significantly reduced inference latency.

摘要（中文）：弥合视觉-语言模型的离散推理与自动驾驶连续、物理约束特性之间的差距仍然是一项重大挑战。本文提出LaPla——一种统一的视觉-语言-动作框架，通过潜在对齐规划将语义理解无缝对接至精确运动执行。我们首先基于残差矢量量化变分自编码器设计动作分词器，该分词器捕获车辆运动学特性并将轨迹特征编码至结构化潜在空间。LaPla并非采用必然引入量化误差的离散码本查找方式，而是将此表示重新用作物理先验，以弥合高维语义与原始动作空间之间的模态鸿沟。具体而言，给定融合多视图图像、历史动作和文本指令的多模态输入，LaPla通过并发动作查询在单次前向传播中因果关注多模态上下文，将隐藏状态直接投影至预训练的VQ-VAE潜在空间。随后冻结的解码器将这些连续潜在变量转化为动作，有效消除量化误差并确保物理合理的轨迹，同时规避耗时的自回归生成。在nuScenes基准上的大量实验表明，LaPla实现了具有竞争力的开环性能，与最先进的VLA方法相比，长时域L2误差降低15.52%。在NVIDIA AlpaSim模拟器上的闭环评估进一步验证了其在保障平滑驾驶进程方面的卓越能力，成功率提升33.34个百分点，同时显著降低推理延迟。

Authors: Ruoyu Yao, Yusen Xie, Qingzhao Liu, Pei Liu, Zewei Yang, Yipeng Zhu, Xiaolong Wang, Jun Ma

MulDP: Multimodal Diffusion Policy for Autonomous Quadruped Parkour Navigation across Complex Terrains Locomotion

multimodal diffusion policy quadruped parkour autonomous navigation velocity command generation visual perception

简要说明：本文提出了 MulDP，一种多模态扩散策略，它整合了视觉感知、本体感知和目标信息，以生成时间上连贯的导航速度指令，实现四足机器人的自主跑酷导航，并构建了首个四足跑酷导航数据集（QPND）。

TLDR: This paper proposes MulDP, a multimodal diffusion policy that integrates visual perception, proprioception, and goal information to generate temporally coherent navigation velocity commands for autonomous quadruped parkour, and introduces the first dedicated parkour navigation dataset (QPND).

Abstract: Quadruped robots have demonstrated impressive agility in parkour locomotion across complex terrains. However, most systems still rely on human intervention for high-level planning, and autonomous parkour navigation remains underexplored. The key challenges include fine-grained velocity regulation, long-horizon anticipatory behaviors, and tight coupling between perception and embodied execution. To address these challenges, we propose a Multimodal Diffusion Policy (MulDP) that integrates visual perception with robot proprioception and goal information to generate temporally coherent and anticipatory navigation velocity commands, tightly coupling perception with embodied control to enable robust autonomous navigation. To support the training of MulDP, we construct the first Quadruped Parkour Navigation Dataset (QPND), a multimodal dataset that encompasses diverse navigation behaviors and complex terrains. Extensive simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate that MulDP enables robust long-horizon autonomous navigation and effective traversal across complex terrains.

摘要（中文）：四足机器人在复杂地形上的跑酷运动已展现出卓越的敏捷性。然而，大多数系统在高层级规划中仍依赖人工干预，自主跑酷导航技术的研究尚不充分。其核心挑战包括：精细速度调控、长时序预判行为，以及感知与具身执行之间的紧密耦合。为解决上述问题，我们提出多模态扩散策略（MulDP），该策略将视觉感知与机器人本体感知及目标信息相融合，生成具有时间连贯性与预判性的导航速度指令，实现感知与具身控制的紧密耦合，从而支撑鲁棒的自主导航。为支持MulDP的训练，我们构建了首个四足跑酷导航数据集（QPND）——一个包含多样化导航行为与复杂地形的多模态数据集。广泛的仿真与实物实验表明，MulDP能够实现长时序自主导航与复杂地形的高效穿越。

Authors: Kangmai Hu, Yueqi Zhang, Peng Zhai, Xiaoyi Wei, Jiabin Hu, Zhixiang Liu, Quancheng Qian, Lihua Zhang

Toward Unified Robot Learning: Bridging Representation, Vision-Language-Action, and World Models RLRobot

unified robot learning representation learning VLA models world models survey

简要说明：本综述将机器人学习研究归纳为三个互补方向——表示学习、视觉-语言-动作模型和世界模型，并指出未来进展需要整合这些组件以提升泛化能力、长时推理和实际部署表现。

TLDR: This survey organizes robot learning research into three complementary axes—representation learning, Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, and world models—and argues that future progress requires integrating these components to improve generalization, long-horizon reasoning, and real-world deployment.

Abstract: For robots to operate reliably in real-world environments, they need to perceive their surroundings, act, and reason about the consequences of those actions. Rapid progress in the domains of representation learning, VLA models, and world models has significantly enhanced the capabilities of robot learning systems, enabling robots to work in increasingly complex environments. However, these paradigms are typically developed in isolation, resulting in fragmented systems that struggle with generalization, long-horizon temporal reasoning and planning, and deployment in unstructured environments. In this survey, we present a unified perspective on robot learning by organizing the existing methods along three complementary axes: understanding through representation learning, acting through VLA models, and reasoning through world models. We introduce a structured taxonomy that captures key design choices in environment representation, policy learning, and predictive modeling, and summarize the recent progress in these domains. Beyond classifying the existing works, we analyze how these components interact, discuss common limitations, and highlight emerging trends towards more integrated systems. Through this lens, we identify the challenges in the domain of robot learning, including uncertainty quantification, out-of-distribution generalization, cross-embodiment transfer, long-context understanding, and long-horizon planning. We argue that these challenges arise not only from limitations within individual components but also from the lack of integration across perception, action, and reasoning. Building on this analysis, we outline future directions towards unified, physically grounded, and probabilistic robot learning to develop robust robotic systems that maintain consistent internal representations and support decision making over extended interactions in real-world environments.

摘要（中文）：为使机器人能在真实环境中可靠运行，它们需要感知周围环境、执行动作，并推理这些动作的后果。表征学习、VLA模型和世界模型等领域的快速发展显著增强了机器人学习系统的能力，使机器人能够在日益复杂的环境中工作。然而，这些范式通常是独立发展的，导致系统碎片化，难以应对泛化、长时序推理与规划以及非结构化环境部署等挑战。本综述通过沿三个互补维度组织现有方法，提出机器人学习的统一视角：通过表征学习实现理解、通过VLA模型实现动作执行、通过世界模型实现推理。我们引入了一种结构化分类体系，涵盖环境表征、策略学习与预测建模中的关键设计选择，并总结了这些领域的最新进展。除对现有工作进行分类外，我们还分析了各组件间的交互方式，讨论了常见的局限性，并指出了迈向更集成系统的趋势。基于这一视角，我们识别出机器人学习领域的挑战，包括不确定性量化、分布外泛化、跨形态迁移、长上下文理解以及长时序规划。我们认为这些挑战不仅源于单个组件的局限性，更源于感知、动作与推理之间缺乏整合。基于这一分析，我们展望了迈向统一、基于物理且概率化的机器人学习的未来方向，以开发出能够维持一致内部表征并支持在真实环境中进行长时间交互决策的稳健机器人系统。

Authors: Shaunak A. Mehta, Ananya Hazarika, Haochen Zhang, Fan Yang, Ryo Moriyama, Wenkai Li, Yash Patel, Kanata Suzuki

Revisiting Topological Graphs for Macro Action based Closed-loop Reinforcement Learning of Vision Language Navigation in Continuous Environment VLN

vision-language navigation hierarchical MDP topological graph macro actions closed-loop RL

简要说明：本文将连续环境下的视觉语言导航（VLN-CE）重新构建为分层马尔可夫决策过程，利用拓扑图构建宏动作空间，从而实现样本高效的闭环强化学习，性能优于先前方法。

TLDR: This paper reformulates Vision-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments (VLN-CE) as a hierarchical MDP with a topological graph-based macro action space, enabling sample-efficient closed-loop reinforcement learning that outperforms prior methods.

Abstract: Vision-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments (VLN-CE) requires an agent to follow natural language instructions through unseen environments. Existing imitation learning (IL) pipelines struggle in this closed-loop setting: behavior cloning suffers from distribution shift, and DAgger's expert actions become ambiguous upon trajectory deviation. While Reinforcement Learning (RL) offers a natural paradigm to address this, directly applying RL to micro action spaces is sample-inefficient due to reward sparsity. To overcome this bottleneck, we reformulate VLN-CE as a Hierarchical Markov Decision Process (MDP), explicitly decoupling high-level planning from low-level control. By abstracting the environment into a topological graph, our high-level policy operates on a macro action space of frontier nodes, with a training-free low-level controller acting as its state transition, which significantly compresses the decision horizon and makes closed-loop RL tractable. To support RL optimization on the macro MDP, we propose an action-aware value head to effectively evaluate state values under the dynamic frontier action space, powering a graph-based PPO. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our architecture. Finally, our model achieves state-of-the-art performance on the R2R-CE and RxR-CE benchmarks.

摘要（中文）：连续环境下的视觉-语言导航（VLN-CE）要求智能体在未知环境中依据自然语言指令进行导航。现有的模仿学习（IL）流程在该闭环设定中面临困境：行为克隆存在分布偏移问题，而DAgger算法在轨迹偏离后会引发专家动作的歧义。尽管强化学习（RL）为这一问题提供了天然范式，但由于奖励稀疏性，直接将RL应用于微观动作空间会导致样本效率低下。为突破这一瓶颈，我们将VLN-CE重新建模为分层马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），明确解耦高层规划与低层控制。通过将环境抽象为拓扑图，我们的高层策略作用于由边界节点构成的宏观动作空间，并通过免训练的低层控制器执行状态转移，从而显著压缩决策步长，使闭环RL变得可行。为支持宏观MDP上的RL优化，我们提出了一种动作感知价值头，以有效评估动态边界动作空间下的状态价值，并以此驱动基于图的PPO算法。大量实验证明了我们架构的有效性。最终，我们的模型在R2R-CE和RxR-CE基准测试中取得了最先进的性能。

Authors: Shuhao Ye, Sitong Mao, Yuxiang Cui, Yufei Wei, Xuan Yu, Shichao Zhai, Wen Chen, Shunbo Zhou, Rong Xiong, Yue Wang

FWBC-VLA: Force-Aware Whole-Body Compensation for Contact-Rich Loco-Manipulation VLA

force-aware VLA whole-body control loco-manipulation sensorless force estimation wheeled-legged robot

简要说明：FWBC-VLA 将无传感器力估计融入 VLA 模型，实现了轮腿机器人的接触丰富移动操作，并在擦白板和开门等真实任务中验证了有效性。

TLDR: FWBC-VLA integrates sensorless force estimation into a VLA model to enable contact-rich loco-manipulation on wheeled-legged robots, demonstrated on real-world tasks like wiping and door opening.

Abstract: Contact-rich loco-manipulation requires a bridge between semantic action generation and physical interaction control. Existing Vision-language-action (VLA) models generate task-level actions from visual and linguistic observations, but cannot interpret the physical interactions induced by those actions. While the whole-body control (WBC) policy can stabilize the robot, it cannot distinguish task-relevant interaction forces from forces induced by external disturbances during manipulation. Although force/torque sensors provide direct measurements of physical interactions, retrofitting them entails additional hardware costs and substantial integration effort, particularly for platforms not designed with sensor integration in mind. To address this problem, we propose FWBC-VLA, a force-aware framework that bridges task-level VLA action generation and low-level whole-body compensation control for wheeled-legged robots. First, we introduce HSR-Force, a sensorless residual-torque estimator for inferring contact strength and its temporal variation. These contact estimates are then encoded as tokens and injected into the VLA action expert during action decoding, enabling the policy to perceive contact onset, sustained loading, and release. For loco-manipulation tasks, all parameters of the pretrained VLA backbone are fine-tuned on our WL\&Arm Dataset, which comprises more than 5,000 episodes. Moreover, the robot's proprioceptive state, the Jacobian-derived body-frame force estimate, and the estimated contact state are jointly fed into a compensation generator to produce corrective actions. The manipulation-centric actions are subsequently combined with the corrective actions and passed to the WBC policy for execution. Real-world experiments on whiteboard wiping and door opening with a door closer demonstrate the effectiveness of our FWBC-VLA in contact-rich loco-manipulation.

摘要（中文）：接触丰富的移动操作需要在语义动作生成与物理交互控制之间建立桥梁。现有的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型能够从视觉和语言观测中生成任务级动作，但无法解释这些动作所引发的物理交互。尽管全身控制（WBC）策略能稳定机器人，却无法在操作过程中区分任务相关的交互力与外部干扰产生的力。虽然力/力矩传感器可直接测量物理交互，但加装这些传感器需要额外的硬件成本和大量的集成工作，尤其对于未预设传感器集成的平台而言。为解决此问题，我们提出FWBC-VLA——一种面向轮腿机器人的力感知框架，该框架桥接了任务级VLA动作生成与底层全身补偿控制。首先，我们引入HSR-Force——一种无需传感器的残余力矩估计器，用于推断接触强度及其时变特征。这些接触估计随后被编码为令牌，在动作解码阶段注入VLA动作专家模块，使策略能够感知接触起始、持续加载与释放过程。针对移动操作任务，预训练VLA主干网络的所有参数均在包含5000余条轨迹的WL&Arm数据集上进行了微调。此外，机器人的本体感知状态、基于雅可比矩阵的机体坐标系力估计以及估计的接触状态被联合输入补偿生成器，以产生修正动作。最终，以操作为中心的动作与修正动作结合后传递给WBC策略执行。在白板擦拭和带闭门器开门任务上的实际实验验证了FWBC-VLA在接触丰富的移动操作中的有效性。

Authors: Yutian Zhang, Siyuan Ma, Liwen Yang, Yang Li, Ce Hao, Haozhen Chi, Dong We, Qiaojun Yu, Dibo Hou

Rethinking World Models for Safety-Critical Embodied Systems WorldModel

world models safety-critical risk-informed counterfactual reasoning epistemic uncertainty

简要说明：本文指出了当前面向安全关键具身系统的世界模型中的结构性不匹配，并提出了以后果、干预、认知不确定性和可恢复性为核心的风险知情世界模型（RIWM）。

TLDR: This paper identifies structural mismatches in current world models for safety-critical embodied systems and proposes the Risk-Informed World Model (RIWM) focusing on consequences, intervention, epistemic uncertainty, and recoverability.

Abstract: World models have progressed from compact latent dynamics to generative, controllable, and interactive simulators of embodied environments. However, high predictive likelihood and visual fidelity do not necessarily ensure that a model preserves the evidence required for safe decision-making. This perspective identifies three structural mismatches in current world modeling: likelihood versus risk, prediction versus intervention, and finite-horizon prediction versus accumulated consequences. We propose the Risk-Informed World Model (RIWM) as a decision-centric research direction for safety-critical embodied systems. RIWM organizes world modeling around consequences, intervention, epistemic uncertainty, and recoverability, and integrates four interdependent capabilities: decision-relevant representation, counterfactual reasoning, safety-critical episodic memory, and runtime safety assurance. It distinguishes physical, social, and operational consequences while using epistemic uncertainty to qualify the evidence supporting action. We further discuss open challenges in identifying consequential futures, validating counterfactual reasoning, maintaining revisable safety memories, translating learned consequences into executable constraints, and determining when evidence is sufficient to act. This perspective argues that future world models should move beyond predicting likely futures toward identifying which futures matter, revising judgments through experience, and recognizing when to act, revise, sense, defer, or abstain.

摘要（中文）：世界模型已从紧凑的潜空间动力学发展为具身环境的生成式、可控且交互式的模拟器。然而，高预测似然性与视觉保真度并不能确保模型保留安全决策所需的证据。本视角识别了当前世界建模中的三个结构性错配：似然性与风险、预测与干预、有限时域预测与累积后果。我们提出风险知情世界模型（RIWM），将其作为面向安全关键型具身系统的决策导向研究方向。RIWM围绕后果、干预、认知不确定性与可恢复性组织世界建模，并整合四项相互依赖的能力：决策相关表征、反事实推理、安全关键型情景记忆以及运行时安全保证。该模型区分物理、社会与运营后果，同时利用认知不确定性来限定支撑行动的证据。我们进一步探讨了以下开放性挑战：识别具有后果性的未来、验证反事实推理、维护可修正的安全记忆、将习得后果转化为可执行约束，以及判定何时证据足以支持行动。本视角主张，未来世界模型应超越预测可能未来，转向识别哪些未来至关重要、通过经验修正判断，并明确何时应当行动、修正、感知、延迟或放弃。

Authors: Kailang Ma, Heye Huang, Inhi Kim, Kitae Jang

Virtual Testing of Automated Driving Systems through Credible Simulations AutonomousDriving

credibility assessment modelling and simulation automated driving systems virtual testing safety evaluation

简要说明：提出一种面向自动驾驶系统仿真工具链的基于风险的置信度评估框架，在验证与确认基础上引入生命周期导向的评估标准。

TLDR: A risk-based credibility assessment framework for simulation toolchains used in automated driving system safety evaluations, extending verification and validation with lifecycle-oriented criteria.

Abstract: Simulation is increasingly used to support safety-related decision-making in road transport, particularly for the assessment and approval of automated driving systems (ADS). The complexity of ADS behavior and size of their operational design domains make exclusive reliance on physical testing impractical, leading to extensive use of virtual testing (VT) during the approval phase. This shift raises critical questions regarding the credibility of modelling and simulation (M&S) results used to support road safety decisions. Current VT accreditation approaches in the ADS domain typically rely on validation-only practices, which have been shown to scale poorly when applied to complex, multi-tool simulation environments. To address this limitation, this paper proposes a risk-based framework for assessing the credibility of simulation toolchains used in ADS safety evaluation, drawing inspiration from established practices in other safety-critical domains, notably NASA's STD-7009 for models and simulations. The framework extends traditional verification and validation (V&V) by explicitly linking credibility requirements to the intended use of simulation outputs and to the safety criticality of the decisions they support within the approval process. It provides a lifecycle-oriented assessment scheme integrating toolchain management, modelling assumptions and limitations, verification, validation, and sensitivity analysis. Credibility acceptance thresholds are defined proportionally, allowing differentiated requirements depending on whether simulation is used for exploratory safety analysis, partial decision support, or as a substitute for physical testing. While demonstrated for ADS, the proposed approach is directly applicable to road safety and simulation studies where VT plays a central role in safety assessment and regulatory decision-making.

摘要（中文）：仿真技术正越来越多地用于支持道路交通中的安全相关决策，尤其是在自动驾驶系统（ADS）的评估与审批中。由于ADS行为的复杂性和运行设计域的规模庞大，仅依赖物理测试并不现实，因此在审批阶段广泛采用虚拟测试（VT）。这一转变引发了关于用于支持道路安全决策的建模与仿真（M&S）结果可信度的关键问题。目前ADS领域的虚拟测试认证方法通常仅依赖验证实践，但此类方法在应用于复杂的多工具仿真环境时扩展性较差。为解决这一局限，本文借鉴其他安全关键领域（特别是NASA针对模型与仿真的STD-7009标准）的成熟实践，提出了一种基于风险的框架，用于评估ADS安全性评估中仿真工具链的可信度。该框架通过将可信度要求与仿真输出的预期用途及其在审批过程中所支持决策的安全关键性明确关联，拓展了传统的验证与确认（V&V）。它提供了一种面向生命周期的评估方案，整合了工具链管理、建模假设与局限性、验证、确认以及敏感性分析。可信度接受阈值采用按比例划分的方式，可根据仿真用于探索性安全分析、部分决策支持还是替代物理测试等不同用途，设定差异化要求。虽然本方法针对ADS进行了论证，但其直接适用于虚拟测试在安全评估和监管决策中发挥核心作用的道路安全及仿真研究领域。

Authors: Riccardo Dona, Espedito Rusciano, Biagio Ciuffo

MINERVA: How Small Can a Manipulation Policy Be and Still Solve LIBERO? Manipulation

VLA manipulation policy capacity floor LIBERO action-chunk length

简要说明：本文系统研究了LIBERO操作基准所需的最小模型容量，发现一个0.54M参数的策略能达到95.1%的成功率，并揭示了标准指令条件作用主要依赖于任务ID记忆。

TLDR: This paper systematically investigates the minimum model capacity required for the LIBERO manipulation benchmark, finding that a 0.54M-parameter policy achieves 95.1% success, and reveals that standard instruction conditioning largely relies on task-ID memorization.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models with billions of parameters now dominate the LIBERO manipulation benchmark, but the model capacity actually required by the benchmark remains unclear. We introduce MINERVA (MINimal Efficient Robotic Vision-Action policy), a family of deliberately compact visuomotor policies designed to measure this task-specific capacity floor. A 0.54M-parameter policy achieves 95.1% average success over 2,000 rollouts on the four standard LIBERO suites, only 2.4 points below the reported LeRobot $π_{0.5}$ result despite using 7,700$\times$ fewer parameters. Performance saturates near 1M parameters and collapses below 0.25M. Across broad architectural, training, and inference sweeps, only action-chunk length and vision capacity consistently exceed a $\pm$1-point training-seed band. Flow matching provides no detectable advantage over direct L1 regression across three seeds, while regression is up to 3.8$\times$ faster on GPU. A task-ID permutation probe shows that standard LIBERO instruction conditioning primarily selects among memorized tasks: changing only the task-ID mapping reduces success to near chance. The same recipe achieves 94.6% success across 89 LIBERO-90 tasks, while LIBERO-Plus perturbations reduce performance to 46--56%, with near-zero robustness to photometric shifts. The 0.54M policy replans every control step in 5--9 ms per chunk on a laptop CPU, 113$\times$ faster than SmolVLA and 1,400$\times$ faster than $π_{0.5}$, without a GPU. These results establish a first empirical estimate of LIBERO's task-specific capacity floor and motivate capacity-aware design and distillation for deployment-efficient robot policies.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）虽以数十亿参数主导了LIBERO操作基准测试，但该基准实际所需的模型容量仍不明确。我们提出MINERVA（最小高效机器人视觉动作策略），这是一系列刻意设计的紧凑型视觉运动策略，用于测量该任务特定的容量下限。一个0.54M参数的策略在四个标准LIBERO任务集的2000次 rollout 中实现了95.1%的平均成功率，虽参数规模缩小7700倍，但仅比已报告的LeRobot π₀.₅结果低2.4个百分点。性能在接近1M参数时趋于饱和，低于0.25M参数时则急剧下降。在涵盖架构、训练与推理的广泛扫描中，只有动作块长度与视觉容量持续超过±1个训练种子带。在三组种子实验下，流匹配相比直接L1回归未展现出可检测优势，而回归在GPU上速度快达3.8倍。任务ID置换探针表明，标准LIBERO指令条件化主要是在记忆化任务中进行选择：仅改变任务ID映射即可使成功率降至接近随机水平。相同配方在89个LIBERO-90任务中实现94.6%成功率，而LIBERO-Plus扰动使性能降至46–56%，对光度变化鲁棒性近乎为零。0.54M策略在笔记本CPU上每控制步的重新规划时间为每块5–9毫秒，比SmolVLA快113倍，比π₀.₅快1400倍，且无需GPU。这些结果首次建立了LIBERO任务特定容量下限的经验估计，并推动面向部署高效机器人策略的容量感知设计与蒸馏研究。

Authors: Kohei Sendai, Tatsuya Matsushima, Yusuke Iwasawa

WISE: World-model-guided Imagination Scheduling for Efficient Post-training of Vision-Language-Action Models VLA

world-model-guided imagination scheduling post-training of VLA models multi-view rollouts robotic manipulation

简要说明：WISE 提出了一种在视觉-语言-动作模型后训练中选择性调度世界模型想象的框架，将 GPU 计算时间减少约 80%，同时提升操作鲁棒性。

TLDR: WISE introduces a framework that selectively schedules world-model imagination during post-training of VLA policies, reducing GPU time by 80% while improving manipulation robustness.

Abstract: Post-training VLA policies typically rely on supervised fine-tuning with costly expert demonstrations or reinforcement learning with expensive and potentially unstable real-world exploration. World models offer a promising alternative by evaluating candidate behaviors through imagined futures, yet effective post-training requires more than accurate prediction: imagination must be scheduled where it is useful, bounded within reliable horizons, and translated into trustworthy policy supervision. In robotic manipulation, the value of imagination varies substantially across execution stages, while extended rollouts can accumulate prediction errors and introduce unreliable learning signals. We introduce WISE (World-model-guided Imagination Scheduling for Efficient Post-training of Vision-Language-Action Models), a unified framework that coordinates when and how world-model imagination is used during policy refinement. WISE selectively invokes imagination at interaction-relevant states, performs bounded multi-view rollouts, evaluates candidate futures using progress and completion signals, and uses their relative outcomes to refine actions generated from real interaction contexts. Extensive experiments with both $π_0$ and $π_{0.5}$ demonstrate consistent improvements across diverse manipulation tasks while reducing GPU computation time by approximately 80% compared with full imagination. Real-world evaluations further show substantial gains in robustness and generalization under diverse real-world distribution shifts.

摘要（中文）：后训练阶段的视觉-语言-动作策略通常依赖于两种方法：一种是通过昂贵专家演示进行监督微调，另一种是通过成本高昂且可能不稳定的真实世界探索进行强化学习。世界模型通过想象未来轨迹评估候选行为，为后训练提供了有前景的替代方案，但有效的后训练不仅需要精确预测：想象必须在其有用之处进行调度、限定在可靠范围之内，并转化为可信的策略监督信号。在机器人操作任务中，想象的价值在不同执行阶段存在显著差异，而长序列展开可能累积预测误差并引入不可靠的学习信号。我们提出WISE（面向视觉-语言-动作模型高效后训练的世界模型引导想象调度）统一框架，该框架协调策略优化过程中世界模型想象的使用时机与方式。WISE在交互相关状态选择性触发想象，执行有界多视角展开，利用进度和完成信号评估候选未来轨迹，并基于其相对结果改进从真实交互环境生成的行动。基于π₀和π_0.5的广泛实验表明，该框架在多种操作任务中实现一致性改进，同时相比完全想象模式减少约80%的GPU计算时间。真实场景评估进一步证明，在多种实际分布偏移条件下，该方法的鲁棒性和泛化能力获得显著提升。

Authors: Chenhao Zhang, Hanyu Zhao, Hang Cheng, Tengfei Pan, Long Zeng

Toward Physically Grounded JEPA World Models for Goal-Conditioned Robotic Planning WorldModel

JEPA world model inverse dynamics state alignment goal-conditioned robotic planning latent prediction

简要说明：该论文提出了一种端到端的JEPA世界模型，通过逆动力学和状态对齐增强潜在预测，以改进目标条件下的机器人规划，在多个基准任务上取得了高成功率。

TLDR: This paper proposes an end-to-end JEPA world model that augments latent prediction with inverse dynamics and state alignment to improve goal-conditioned robotic planning, achieving high success rates on several benchmark tasks.

Abstract: Action-conditioned JEPA world models enable planning toward visually specified goals without reconstructing future pixels, yet latent prediction alone does not explicitly encourage the learned representations to retain information relevant to robotic control. We introduce an end-to-end JEPA world model that augments latent prediction with inverse dynamics (IDM) and state alignment (SA). While inverse dynamics discourages latent collapse and makes latent transitions informative of the actions that produced them, state alignment grounds consecutive representations in their associated physical configuration and motion. Across four benchmark tasks, our model attains the highest success rates on TwoRoom (100%), PushT (98%), and OGBench-Cube (87%), while performing comparably to LeWorldModel on Reacher. Our ablation further shows that adding state alignment consistently improves planning success over IDM alone across all four tasks. Although LeWorldModel, our primary baseline, attains higher average straightening on OGBench-Cube, transition-subspace analysis shows that its transition energy is concentrated in a substantially lower-dimensional subspace. Our state-aligned model exhibits a higher effective transition dimension than LeWorldModel and improves planning over IDM alone, supporting state alignment as an effective complement to inverse dynamics for robotic planning.

摘要（中文）：基于动作条件的JEPA世界模型能够在无需重建未来像素的情况下，实现对视觉指定目标的规划，然而仅靠潜变量预测并不能明确促使所学表征保留与机器人控制相关的信息。我们提出了一种端到端的JEPA世界模型，该模型通过逆动力学（IDM）和状态对齐（SA）增强潜变量预测。逆动力学不仅可以防止潜变量坍缩，还能使潜变量转换过程包含产生这些转换的动作信息；而状态对齐则将连续的表征与其相关的物理构型和运动建立联系。在四项基准任务中，我们的模型在TwoRoom（100%）、PushT（98%）和OGBench-Cube（87%）上取得了最高成功率，在Reacher任务上与LeWorldModel表现相当。我们的消融实验进一步表明，在所有四项任务中，相较于仅使用IDM，增加状态对齐均能持续提升规划成功率。尽管我们的主要基线模型LeWorldModel在OGBench-Cube上获得了更高的平均矫直度，但转换子空间分析显示，其转换能量集中于维数显著更低的子空间。我们的状态对齐模型展现出比LeWorldModel更高的有效转换维度，并且相较于仅使用IDM提升了规划性能，这证明状态对齐是机器人规划中逆动力学的有效补充。

Authors: Muyuan Liu, Yue Huang, Zheng Liang, Xiang Gao

BRIDGE: An Open-Source Humanoid Platform via Morphology-Control Co-Design for Physical AI HumanoidEmbodied

morphology-control co-design humanoid robot kinematic retargeting dynamic tracking open-source platform

简要说明：本文提出了一种数据驱动的形态-控制协同设计框架，用于人形机器人，集成了运动学重映射和动态跟踪指标，并开源了Bridge平台及其控制策略，实现了更优的类人运动。

TLDR: This paper presents a data-driven morphology-control co-design framework for humanoid robots, integrating kinematic retargeting and dynamic tracking metrics, and releases the open-source Bridge platform with control policies that achieve superior human-like movement.

Abstract: Developing humanoid robots capable of leveraging human behavioral data is essential for general-purpose embodiment, yet conventional development remains bottlenecked by a decoupled paradigm that isolates hardware design from whole-body control. This approach leads to suboptimal systems that compromise human-like fluidity and agility. To bridge this gap, we introduce a data-driven morphology-control co-design framework that optimizes humanoid morphology for human-like movement. To quantify morphological fidelity, we also introduce a novel metric that jointly considers kinematic retargeting fidelity to human motion and dynamic tracking performance. Our framework achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance across all metrics compared to baseline humanoids (Bumi, K1, and Toddlerbot). Finally, we realize this design in Bridge, an open-source, 88cm-tall humanoid platform released alongside its control policy. We demonstrate that Bridge captures human motion data with superior fidelity, exhibiting exceptional performance across foundational locomotion, robust balance, and highly dynamic maneuvers. Videos and open-source materials: https://sites.google.com/view/bridgerobot.

摘要（中文）：开发能够利用人类行为数据的人形机器人对于通用具身智能至关重要，然而传统开发仍受限于将硬件设计与全身控制相分离的解耦范式。这种割裂的方法导致系统性能欠佳，无法实现类人流畅性与敏捷性。为弥合这一鸿沟，我们提出一种数据驱动的形态-控制协同设计框架，针对类人运动优化人形机器人形态。为量化形态保真度，我们引入一种新型度量指标，该指标联合考量运动重定向对人类运动的保真度以及动态跟踪性能。与基线人形机器人（Bumi、K1、Toddlerbot）相比，我们的框架在所有指标上均达到当前最优性能。最终，我们将该设计实现为Bridge——一款开源88厘米高的人形机器人平台，并同步发布其控制策略。实验证明，Bridge能以卓越保真度捕获人类运动数据，在基础步态、鲁棒平衡及高动态机动中均表现出色。视频与开源材料：https://sites.google.com/view/bridgerobot。

Authors: Jianren Wang, Letian Qian, Zikai Wang, Weiwei Wu, Junjie Zong, Abhinav Gupta, Deepak Pathak

Air-Ground Collaborative Vision-and-Language Navigation via Shared Bird's-Eye Maps VLN

Air-Ground Collaborative VLN bird's-eye map training-free VLM-based navigation UAV-UGV cooperation

简要说明：本文提出了AGC-VLN，首个无需训练的空地协同视觉语言导航基线方法，通过共享鸟瞰图将导航分解为基于VLM的语义推理和确定性几何执行，在CARLA-Air仿真中实现了77.0%的联合成功率。

TLDR: This paper introduces AGC-VLN, the first training-free baseline for air-ground collaborative Vision-and-Language Navigation, which decomposes navigation into VLM-based semantic reasoning and deterministic geometric execution using a shared bird's-eye map, achieving a 77.0% joint success rate in CARLA-Air simulations.

Abstract: Air-ground collaborative Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) pairs an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) with a global bird's-eye view and an unmanned ground vehicle (UGV) with a local first-person view, yet the setting remains largely unexplored: existing training-free methods solve single-agent tasks but offer no collaboration mechanism, and a recent CARLA-Air evaluation found no stable cooperative behavior across five state-of-the-art VLA models; naive semantic communication or bidirectional coupling even degrades performance. We establish AGC-VLN (Air-Ground Collaborative VLN), the first training-free baseline for air-ground collaborative VLN. The key insight is that training-free methods decompose navigation into VLM-based semantic reasoning and deterministic geometric execution, exposing a collaboration interface: the UAV's global view, over which it renders the UGV's reported pose and the VLM-anchored target as CAR/GOAL markers with distance labels, yielding a shared bird's-eye map. From this map, the UGV acquires global spatial context its first-person view cannot provide, plans a road-following path with a frozen VLM, and executes it under closed-loop control; in parallel, the UAV runs 3D-SPF, a spatial-search upgrade of SPF that localizes the target in the downward view and flies toward it. On 100 closed-loop episodes in CARLA-Air's Town10HD scene, AGC-VLN reaches a 77.0% joint success rate, a collaboration gain of +27.0% over the weaker individual agent (the UAV, 50.0%), and exceeds the strongest published single-agent baseline (Travel UAV, 53.0%) by 24.0 points, stemming from the complementarity of the UAV's global view and the UGV's road-following execution. Project page: https://github.com/ZSN2024/AGC-VLN.

摘要（中文）：空地协同视觉与语言导航（Air-ground Collaborative Vision-and-Language Navigation, VLN）将具备全局鸟瞰视角的无人机与具备局部第一人称视角的地面无人车配对，但该设置仍未被充分探索：现有无训练方法仅能解决单智能体任务，缺乏协作机制；且近期一项CARLA-Air评估发现，五种最先进的VLA模型均未表现出稳定的协同行为；简单的语义通信或双向耦合甚至会导致性能下降。我们建立了AGC-VLN（空地协同VLN），这是首个面向空地协同VLN的无训练基线。关键洞察在于：无训练方法将导航分解为基于VLM的语义推理与确定性几何执行，从而暴露出一个协作接口——无人机提供的全局视图，该视图上渲染了地面无人车报告的位姿以及由VLM锚定的目标，并将其表示为带有距离标签的CAR/GOAL标记，形成共享的鸟瞰地图。基于该地图，地面无人车获得了其第一人称视角无法提供的全局空间上下文，利用冻结的VLM规划出沿道路行进路径，并在闭环控制下执行该路径；与此同时，无人机运行3D-SPF（一种针对SPF的空间搜索升级版），在下视视角中定位目标并朝其飞行。在CARLA-Air的Town10HD场景中进行的100次闭环测试中，AGC-VLN达到了77.0%的联合成功率，相对于较弱的单智能体（无人机，50.0%）实现了+27.0%的协作增益，并超出已发表的最强单智能体基线（Travel UAV，53.0%）24.0个百分点，这得益于无人机全局视图与地面无人车沿道路行进执行的互补性。项目页面：https://github.com/ZSN2024/AGC-VLN。

Authors: Shuning Zhang, Liang Li, Yunheng Wang, Tao Wang, Yihang Kang, Renjing Xu

R2S-Eval: Robot Evaluation with Real-to-Sim Calibration via Vision-Language Models Manipulation

real-to-sim calibration VLM preference evaluation robot policy evaluation rollout videos behavior quality

简要说明：R2S-Eval 提出了一种结合真实到仿真校准和视觉语言模型偏好评估的机器人策略评价流水线，减少了重复硬件试验的需求，生成了可靠且关注行为质量的策略排名。

TLDR: R2S-Eval introduces a real-to-sim calibration and VLM-based preference evaluation pipeline that reduces the need for repeated hardware trials in robot manipulation policy assessment, producing reliable and quality-aware policy rankings.

Abstract: Evaluating robot manipulation policies is becoming increasingly important as generalist models, particularly vision-language-action (VLA) models, are deployed on physical robots. However, conventional real-world evaluation remains labor-intensive, unstable, and insufficiently informative. It requires repeated hardware trials, manual scene resets, and continuous operator monitoring, may produce different policy rankings across repeated evaluations, and primarily relies on success-rate metrics that provide limited information about execution quality. In contrast, humans assess robot performance by observing and comparing complete behaviors rather than relying solely on binary success outcomes. To this end, we propose R2S-Eval, an evaluation pipeline that combines real-to-sim calibration with vision-language model (VLM) preference evaluation. The real-to-sim component efficiently generates rollout videos in a simulator calibrated to the real-world evaluation setting, thereby reducing the need for repeated hardware trials. The VLM evaluator assesses the execution quality of rollout videos and produces pairwise preferences, which are subsequently aggregated into policy rankings. We further introduce a protocol to assess whether the proposed evaluation pipeline yields validated policy conclusions while mitigating the key challenges of conventional real-world evaluation. Experiments in both simulation and real-world settings demonstrate that R2S-Eval produces reliable and stable policy conclusions, achieves agreement with human preferences, substantially reduces repeated hardware-operation effort, and reveals behavior-quality differences that are not captured by binary success labels. In general, R2S-Eval advances robot evaluation from manual success counting toward automated, statistically stable, and quality-aware evaluation of robot behavior. Project page: https://r2s-eval.github.io.

摘要（中文）：摘要：随着通用模型（尤其是视觉-语言-动作模型，VLA）被部署至实体机器人，机器人操作策略的评估正变得愈发重要。然而，传统真实环境评估仍存在劳动力密集、结果不稳定、信息量不足等问题。这类评估需要重复硬件试验、人工场景重置及持续操作员监控，多次评估可能产生不同的策略排名，且主要依赖成功率指标，对执行质量的信息反馈有限。相比之下，人类通过观察和比较完整行为来评估机器人性能，而非仅依赖二元成功结果。为此，我们提出R2S-Eval评估流程，该流程将真实-仿真标定与视觉-语言模型偏好评估相结合。其中，真实-仿真组件可在标定至真实评估环境的仿真器中高效生成滚动视频，从而减少重复硬件试验需求；视觉-语言模型评估器则通过评估滚动视频的执行质量生成成对偏好，进而聚合并形成策略排名。我们进一步引入评估协议，验证该评估流程能否在规避传统真实环境评估关键挑战的同时，得出经过验证的策略结论。仿真与真实环境实验表明，R2S-Eval可产生可靠且稳定的策略结论，实现与人类偏好的高度一致，显著降低重复硬件操作负担，并揭示二元成功标签无法捕捉的行为质量差异。总体而言，R2S-Eval将机器人评估从人工成功计数推进至自动化、统计稳定且感知质量的行为评估范式。项目页面：https://r2s-eval.github.io。

Authors: Yidi Wang, Feixiang Ruan, Ruoqu Chen, Jie Yin, Yang Yu, Mengdi Xu, Kaifeng Zhang

Long-Horizon Consistent and Interaction-Aware World Models for Multi-Style End-to-End Driving AutonomousDriving

world model end-to-end driving temporal consistency state disentanglement multi-style driving

简要说明：StyleDrive提出了一种基于世界模型的端到端自动驾驶强化学习框架，通过长期时域一致性约束、显式解耦自车-环境交互状态以及轨迹级优势优化实现多风格驾驶。

TLDR: StyleDrive proposes a world-model-based reinforcement learning framework for end-to-end autonomous driving that enforces long-horizon temporal consistency, explicitly disentangles ego-environment interactions, and enables multi-style driving via trajectory-wise advantage optimization.

Abstract: End-to-end autonomous driving has increasingly adopted world model-based reinforcement learning frameworks to improve learning efficiency through \textit{imagined rollouts}. However, existing world models suffer from three key limitations: temporal inconsistency in long-horizon imagined rollouts, inadequate modeling of ego-environment interactions, and limited adaptability to diverse driving styles. To address these challenges, we propose \textit{StyleDrive}, a world-model-based learning framework that jointly enforces long-horizon consistency, explicitly disentangles interactive traffic states, and supports multi-style policy optimization within a unified learning paradigm. First, we introduce a temporal consistency regularization that integrates historical latent states through gated cross-attention, stabilizing long-horizon imagined rollouts and mitigating error accumulation. Second, we design an explicit state disentanglement module that separates ego-relevant from ego-irrelevant interactive states, enabling more interpretable and efficient decision-making in complex traffic scenarios. Third, we enable multi-style driving behaviors through Group Relative Policy Optimization, which replaces per-step reward optimization with trajectory-wise relative advantages, reducing reward variance and supporting diverse driving styles without retraining. We evaluate StyleDrive on the Bench2Drive closed-loop driving benchmark, achieving a driving score of 88.44 (+17.08 over the previous best world model-based method) and a success rate of 66.82 (+16.58). Furthermore, we deploy StyleDrive on a real automated guided vehicle platform and demonstrate promising sim-to-real transfer capability in dynamic driving scenarios.

摘要（中文）：端到端自动驾驶系统中，基于世界模型的强化学习框架日益普及，通过“想象推演”提升学习效率。然而，现有世界模型存在三个关键局限：长时域想象推演中的时间不一致性、对自车-环境交互建模不充分、以及对多样化驾驶风格的适应性有限。为应对这些挑战，我们提出StyleDrive——一种基于世界模型的学习框架，该框架能在统一学习范式内同时保证长时域一致性、显式解耦交互交通状态，并支持多风格策略优化。首先，我们引入时间一致性正则化机制，通过门控交叉注意力整合历史隐状态，稳定长时域想象推演并抑制误差累积。其次，我们设计显式状态解耦模块，将自车相关与自车无关的交互状态分离，提升复杂交通场景中决策的可解释性与效率。第三，我们通过群体相对策略优化实现多风格驾驶行为，以轨迹级相对优势替代逐步奖励优化，降低奖励方差并支持无需重新训练的多样化驾驶风格。在Bench2Drive闭环驾驶基准测试中，StyleDrive取得88.44的驾驶评分（较之前最优基于世界模型的方法提升17.08）和66.82%的成功率（提升16.58%）。此外，我们在真实自动导引车平台上部署StyleDrive，并在动态驾驶场景中展现出优异的仿真到现实迁移能力。

Authors: Yuxuan Han, Kunyuan Wu, Liyunong Yang, Zilu Wang, Cansen Jiang, Yi Xiao, Liang Hu

RoboTok: An Internet-Scale Data Engine for Human Demonstration Retrieval and Dexterous Manipulation Learning Manipulation

internet-scale data engine human demonstration retrieval dexterous manipulation latent motion space hand-pose trajectory retrieval

简要说明：RoboTok 是一个互联网规模的数据引擎，通过从 3D 手部轨迹学习潜在运动空间，从网络视频中检索人类操作演示，为灵巧机器人策略学习提供可扩展的监督。

TLDR: RoboTok is an internet-scale data engine that retrieves human manipulation demonstrations from web videos by learning a latent motion space from 3D hand trajectories, enabling scalable supervision for dexterous robot policy learning.

Abstract: Robot learning increasingly depends on broad and diverse demonstrations, yet collecting robot data remains expensive and poorly suited to covering the long tail of real-world tasks. To address this bottleneck, we introduce RoboTok, an internet-scale data engine that, given a query human manipulation video, retrieves manipulation-relevant human demonstrations from web videos for training dexterous robot policies. Specifically, we learn a latent motion space from 3D hand trajectories expressed in estimated actor-centered reference frames. This representation enables manipulation behaviors to be compared across variations in camera viewpoint, scene appearance, and actor occlusions, while remaining compact enough for efficient search and continual indexing over internet-scale video collections. We evaluate RoboTok against existing robot-data retrieval approaches on retrieval benchmarks and downstream robot policy performance. Our results show that RoboTok retrieves more relevant manipulation demonstrations and improves downstream task success, establishing hand-pose trajectory-aware retrieval as a way to make web video a scalable and continuously growing source of supervision for robot learning.

摘要（中文）：机器人学习日益依赖于广泛且多样化的示教数据，然而收集机器人数据仍然成本高昂，难以覆盖实际任务中的长尾分布。为解决这一瓶颈，我们提出RoboTok——一个互联网规模的数据引擎，能够针对给定的人体操作视频查询，从网络视频中检索与操作相关的示教数据，用于训练灵巧机器人策略。具体而言，我们从以估计的受试者中心参考系表达的3D手部轨迹中学习潜在运动空间。该表征使得操作行为能够在摄像机视角、场景外观及受试者遮挡等变化条件下进行跨样本比较，同时保持足够紧凑以实现对互联网规模视频集合的高效搜索与持续索引。我们通过检索基准测试及下游机器人策略性能，将RoboTok与现有机器人数据检索方法进行了对比评估。结果表明，RoboTok能检索到更相关的操作示教数据，并提升下游任务成功率，由此确立了基于手部姿态轨迹感知的检索方法作为使网络视频成为机器人学习可扩展且持续增长的监督源的可行路径。

Authors: Howard Qian, Yiting Chen, Yunfei Xie, Kejia Ren, Podshara Chanrungmaneekul, Gaotian Wang, Bowen Wen, Chen Wei, Kaiyu Hang

Drive-HWM: Hierarchical World Models for Dynamic-Latent Guided Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

Hierarchical world model slow-fast framework dynamic-aware latent next-frame prediction autonomous driving

简要说明：Drive-HWM 提出了一种分层慢-快世界模型用于自动驾驶，在慢时间尺度预测未来场景表征以实现长程预见，并通过快模型联合预测下一帧和即时动作，在NAVSIM基准上取得了优异性能。

TLDR: Drive-HWM proposes a hierarchical slow-fast world model for autonomous driving that predicts future scene representations at a slow timescale for long-horizon anticipation and uses a fast model for joint next-frame and action prediction, achieving strong performance on NAVSIM benchmarks.

Abstract: World models offer a promising paradigm for autonomous driving by predicting how traffic scenes may evolve and using such predictions to support action generation. However, existing approaches either separate future prediction from action generation or jointly predict them at the same temporal scale, making it difficult to simultaneously achieve long-horizon anticipation and responsive, observation-grounded decision making. We present Drive-HWM, a hierarchical slow--fast world modeling framework that organizes future representation prediction and action generation at complementary temporal scales. The slow world model predicts multi-step future representations to capture extended scene evolution. To explicitly model the abundant motion dynamics in driving environments, we introduce Dynamic-Aware Latents learned through optical-flow prediction. Guided by these future representations, the fast model uses a lightweight multimodal backbone and an autoregressive expert to jointly predict the next frame and the immediate action from the latest observation. Next-frame prediction encourages the fast model to capture imminent scene evolution, while one-step action generation allows decisions to be continuously updated as new observations arrive. Extensive experiments on NAVSIM v1 and v2 demonstrate the strong driving performance of Drive-HWM. Comprehensive ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of the hierarchical slow--fast design, dynamics-aware future representations, and joint next-frame and action prediction.

摘要（中文）：世界模型通过预测交通场景的演化方式，并利用此类预测支持动作生成，为自动驾驶提供了一种极具前景的范式。然而，现有方法要么将未来预测与动作生成相分离，要么在相同的时间尺度上对二者进行联合预测，这使得同时实现长时域预判与基于观测的响应式决策变得困难。我们提出Drive-HWM——一种分层式快慢世界建模框架，该框架在互补的时间尺度上组织未来表征预测与动作生成。慢世界模型预测多步未来表征以捕捉扩展的场景演化。为显式建模驾驶环境中丰富的运动动态，我们引入了通过光流预测学习到的动态感知隐变量。在这些未来表征的引导下，快世界模型采用轻量级多模态骨干网络与自回归专家模型，从最新观测中联合预测下一帧图像及即时动作。下一帧预测促使快世界模型捕捉即将发生的场景演化，而单步动作生成则使决策能够随着新观测的到来持续更新。在NAVSIM v1和v2上的大量实验证明了Drive-HWM强大的驾驶性能。全面的消融研究进一步验证了分层式快慢设计、动态感知未来表征以及下一帧与动作联合预测的有效性。

Authors: Zhaoxin Fan, Tianbao Zhang, Wenjun Wu, Xiaofeng Wang, Yeying Jin, Jian Zhao, Zheng Zhu, Shuicheng Yan

Building Pretraining Data for World Models: An Unreal Engine-Based Pipeline for Action-Conditioned Video Generation WorldModel

action-conditioned video generation synthetic data pipeline Unreal Engine world model pretraining multi-view video

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于虚幻引擎的大规模合成数据生产管线，用于生成动作条件多视角视频，该管线直接作为EchoWM世界模型的预训练数据组件。

TLDR: This paper presents a large-scale synthetic data production pipeline built on Unreal Engine for generating action-conditioned, multi-view video, which is directly used as the pretraining data component for the EchoWM world model.

Abstract: Action-conditioned video models require large-scale visual data paired with control signals that are temporally aligned with the resulting scene transitions. Such supervision is difficult to obtain from ordinary real-world video because the actions that caused each visual change are typically unknown. We present a large-scale synthetic data production pipeline built on Unreal Engine for generating action-conditioned, multi-view video. To accommodate the different execution requirements of real-time physics and high-quality offline rendering, the pipeline executes trajectory generation and final rendering in two stages: Stage I runs real physics in PIE and records per-frame character states, control inputs, and camera states into an intermediate trajectory representation; Stage II replays those trajectories in a new engine process and renders them offline with Movie Render Queue (MRQ). Around this core, we develop a distributed production system with cache-aware task partitioning, node-local slot scheduling, automated scene screening, aesthetic and luminance filtering, partial-output recovery, asynchronous upload, and continuous cluster health monitoring. The production cluster contains 25 servers with eight NVIDIA RTX 5090 GPUs per server. From 2,384 asset packs, 429 levels were retained for production together with a pool of 40 humanoid characters. The pipeline has produced 2,691 hours of 1080p video and 6,076 hours of 720p video. We describe the system architecture, the implementation decisions that emerged from production failures, and the limitations of using perceptual quality proxies for world-model data curation. The pipeline described in this report constitutes the Unreal Engine synthetic-data production component used in EchoWM.

摘要（中文）：基于动作条件的视频模型需要大规模视觉数据，以及与时序场景转换同步的控制信号。由于普通真实世界视频中导致每次视觉变化的动作通常未知，因此难以获取此类监督数据。我们提出了一种基于虚幻引擎的大规模合成数据生产管线，用于生成基于动作条件的多视角视频。为兼顾实时物理模拟与高质量离线渲染的不同执行需求，该管线分两阶段执行轨迹生成与最终渲染：第一阶段在PIE模式下运行真实物理引擎，将每帧角色状态、控制输入及相机状态记录为中间轨迹表示；第二阶段在新引擎进程中重放这些轨迹，并利用Movie Render Queue（MRQ）进行离线渲染。围绕这一核心，我们开发了分布式生产系统，包含缓存感知任务分区、节点本地时隙调度、自动化场景筛选、美学与亮度过滤、部分输出恢复、异步上传及持续集群健康监测功能。生产集群由25台服务器组成，每台配备八块NVIDIA RTX 5090 GPU。从2,384个资源包中筛选出429个关卡用于生产，同时配置40个人形角色库。该管线已生成2,691小时1080p视频与6,076小时720p视频。本文描述了系统架构、生产故障中产生的实现决策，以及在用于世界模型数据整理时使用感知质量代理的局限性。本报告所述管线构成了EchoWM中使用的虚幻引擎合成数据生产组件。

Authors: Haoyu Wang, Songchun Zhang, Haoran Li, Haoyang Huang, Zeyue Xue, Nan Duan

Latent Energy Action Planning with World Models WorldModel

world models model predictive control latent energy action planning quasi-Newton solver

简要说明：LEAP通过将终端潜在目标匹配与终端窗口状态能量相结合，并通过拟牛顿求解器在冻结的世界模型中优化动作，显著提高了模型预测控制的成功率。

TLDR: LEAP improves model predictive control by coupling terminal latent goal matching with a terminal-window state energy, optimized via a quasi-Newton solver through a frozen world model, achieving significant success rate improvements over cross-entropy method planning.

Abstract: Latent world models support efficient model predictive control from high-dimensional observations, yet optimizing a single learned latent objective can favor action sequences whose decoder-predicted terminal descriptor does not match the goal descriptor. We introduce Latent Energy Action Planning (LEAP), which treats the complete action horizon as a differentiable variable and optimizes it through a frozen LeWorldModel (LeWM). LEAP couples terminal latent goal matching with a terminal-window state energy. Low energy requires the predicted terminal latent to agree with the goal latent and the decoder-predicted terminal descriptor to agree with the goal descriptor. A frozen goal-conditioned proposal initializes the search, a quasi-Newton solver refines actions through the autoregressive rollout, and post-optimization projection enforces the admissible action range. Across four control domains using the officially released LeWM checkpoints, the complete LEAP planning system raises mean success from 77.5% for LeWM planned with the cross-entropy method (LeWM+CEM) to 94.8% under a matched protocol, a 17.3-percentage-point improvement, while retaining the frozen LeWM representation and predictor.

摘要（中文）：潜世界模型支持从高维观测中实现高效的模型预测控制，然而优化单一学习到的潜变量目标可能会导致解码器预测的终端描述符与目标描述符不匹配的动作序列。我们提出了潜能量动作规划（LEAP），该方法将完整的动作时域视为可微变量，并通过冻结的潜世界模型（LeWM）对其进行优化。LEAP将终端潜目标匹配与终端窗口状态能量相结合。低能量要求预测的终端潜变量与目标潜变量一致，且解码器预测的终端描述符与目标描述符一致。冻结的目标条件化提议初始化搜索过程，拟牛顿求解器通过自回归展开优化动作，优化后投影确保动作处于允许范围内。在四个控制领域中，使用官方发布的LeWM检查点，完整的LEAP规划系统在匹配协议下将平均成功率从LeWM结合交叉熵方法（LeWM+CEM）的77.5%提升至94.8%，提升了17.3个百分点，同时保持了LeWM表示和预测器的冻结状态。

Authors: Phu Pham, Aniket Bera

Adaptive Vision-Language Grasping via Composable Foundation Priors and Generalizable Grasp Synthesis Manipulation

vision-language-grasping generalizable grasp synthesis composable foundation priors force-closure stability cross-hand generalization

简要说明：AdaRoboVLG 通过运动学映射和力闭合稳定性估计的基础策略与可组合的基础模型先验解耦了物理抓取合成与任务理解，支持跨机械手泛化且无需重新训练。

TLDR: AdaRoboVLG decouples physical grasp synthesis from task-dependent understanding using a base policy with kinematic and force-closure constraints, with composable foundation-model priors for adaptive grasping without retraining.

Abstract: This paper proposes AdaRoboVLG, a task-adaptive Vision-Language-Grasp (VLG) framework that supports generalizable grasp synthesis across different robotic hands. Unlike existing VLG methods that tightly couple foundation models with end-to-end grasp policies, AdaRoboVLG learns an efficient generalizable base policy that generates and evaluates physically feasible grasp candidates through explicit kinematic mapping and force-closure-based stability estimation, while offloading task-dependent understanding to specialized foundation-model modules. These modules provide composable priors that are integrated into the grasp synthesis process, enabling contextually adaptive grasp synthesis without retraining the underlying grasp policy. Through extensive simulation and real-world experiments, we demonstrate that (i) the base policy exhibits efficient learning and strong cross-hand generalization, (ii) the framework effectively incorporates spatial, cognitive, and temporal priors to address three representative grasping challenges without compromising grasp synthesis performance compared to state-of-the-art methods, and (iii) these priors can operate jointly to enable functional grasping in cluttered and dynamic environments. These results indicate that decoupling physical grasp synthesis from task-dependent understanding provides a scalable paradigm for robotic grasping, allowing future advances in foundation models to be directly translated into improved grasp capabilities without redesigning or retraining the underlying grasp policy. Supplementary videos are available at https://adarobovlg.github.io/

摘要（中文）：本文提出AdaRoboVLG，一种任务自适应的视觉-语言-抓取（VLG）框架，支持跨不同机器人手的泛化抓取合成。与现有将基础模型与端到端抓取策略紧密耦合的VLG方法不同，AdaRoboVLG学习一种高效的泛化基础策略，该策略通过显式运动学映射和基于力闭合的稳定性估计来生成并评估物理可行的抓取候选，同时将任务相关的理解任务卸载至专门的基础模型模块。这些模块提供可组合的先验知识，并集成到抓取合成过程中，使得无需重新训练底层抓取策略即可实现上下文自适应的抓取合成。通过大量仿真和真实世界实验，我们证明：（i）基础策略表现出高效的学习能力和强大的跨手泛化能力；（ii）该框架有效整合空间、认知和时间先验知识，以解决三种代表性抓取挑战，且相较于最先进方法不牺牲抓取合成性能；（iii）这些先验知识可联合运作，在杂乱和动态环境中实现功能性抓取。这些结果表明，将物理抓取合成与任务相关理解解耦，为机器人抓取提供了一种可扩展的范式，使得基础模型的未来进展能够直接转化为改进的抓取能力，而无需重新设计或重新训练底层抓取策略。补充视频见https://adarobovlg.github.io/。

Authors: Sixu Yan, Shikang Wang, Binhua Huang, Xuanlai Tang, Guohua Fan, Fan Huang, Haoxuan Li, Yongkang Li, Yuhan Li, Bencheng Liao, Zeyu Zhang, Wenyu Liu, Hangxin Liu, Xinggang Wang

Robot Aware Computational Design of Object Specific Passive Grippers for Additive Manufacturing Manipulation

passive gripper design computational design topology optimization pose registration additive manufacturing

简要说明：本文提出了一种端到端的计算流程，用于设计针对特定对象的被动夹具，该夹具无需驱动、可增材制造，并通过配准、接触采样、运动学和拓扑优化与给定的对象网格、机械臂和位姿紧密结合。

TLDR: This paper presents an end-to-end computational pipeline for designing object-specific, unactuated passive grippers that are additively manufacturable and tightly coupled to a given object mesh, robot arm, and pose via registration, contact sampling, kinematics, and topology optimization.

Abstract: This paper presents an end-to-end computational pipeline that converts a selected object mesh, a measured object state, and a selected six-axis robot into an object-specific, unactuated, additively manufacturable gripper. The method couples exact-mesh RGB-D/ICP pose registration, deterministic surface-contact sampling, uncertainty-aware wrench screening, selection among six passive capture mechanisms, object-conformal surface synthesis, full-orientation robot inverse kinematics, a swept-volume-aware manufacturing domain, directional fused-deposition finite-element screening, and constrained three-dimensional SIMP topology optimization. Unlike workflows that treat grasp selection, tool geometry, motion, and structural design as separate problems, every exported design is bound to the source mesh, object pose, robot flange, contact set, and insertion hypothesis by a traceable design identifier. We derive the implemented registration, contact, fit-tolerance, finite-element, and density-optimization equations and prove three properties of the numerical construction: nodal load preservation, monotonic compliance sensitivity under SIMP interpolation, and voxel-domain containment after topology post-processing. Four archived object-specific attempts - a rabbit, camera flange, 3DBenchy, and faceted bust - meet the nominal fit, uncertain-wrench, runtime-sweep, and baseline/post-topology FEA gates. A deliberately enlarged +/-3 mm, +/-5 degree pose stress check differentiates the designs, retaining 29-134 of 160 simulated trials. Their reconstructed topologies retain 92.0-97.6% of the FE domain because functional regions are protected. Archived robot photographs show the corresponding printed assemblies qualitatively, while nominal material properties and absent coupon-calibrated, instrumented tests keep all four at digital-screening status rather than operational release.

摘要（中文）：本文提出了一种端到端的计算流程，能够将选定的物体网格、测量的物体状态以及选定的六轴机器人转化为针对特定物体的非驱动式、可增材制造的夹爪。该方法整合了精确网格的RGB-D/ICP位姿配准、确定性表面接触采样、考虑不确定性的力旋量筛选、六种被动抓取机构的选择、物体共形表面合成、全姿态机器人逆运动学、考虑扫掠体积的制造域、定向熔融沉积有限元筛选以及约束三维SIMP拓扑优化。与将抓取选择、工具几何、运动规划和结构设计作为独立问题处理的工作流程不同，每个导出设计都通过可追溯的设计标识符与源网格、物体位姿、机器人法兰、接触集和插入假设相关联。我们推导了所实现的配准、接触、配合公差、有限元和密度优化方程，并证明了数值构造的三个性质：节点载荷保持性、SIMP插值下的单调柔顺灵敏度以及拓扑后处理后的体素域包含性。四个归档的特定物体尝试——兔子、相机法兰、3DBenchy和刻面半身像——均通过了名义配合、不确定力旋量、运行时间扫掠以及基准/后拓扑有限元分析的门槛。通过故意放大的±3毫米、±5度位姿应力检查区分了设计，在160次模拟试验中保留了29-134次。由于功能区域受到保护，重建的拓扑保留了有限元域的92.0%-97.6%。归档的机器人照片定性地展示了相应的打印组件，而名义材料属性以及未经标定的试片、仪器测试使所有四个设计保持在数字筛选状态，而非可操作发布。

Authors: Abdullah Yahya Abdullah Omaisan, Ibrahim Sheikh Mohamed

RoughSense: Lightweight Terrain-Induced Rover Vibration Prediction Using Point Clouds and IMU Feedback Locomotion

terrain vibration prediction LiDAR point cloud IMU feedback traversability mapping RANSAC

简要说明：本文提出了一种轻量级方法，利用激光雷达点云和IMU反馈预测火星车振动，实现振动感知的可通行性映射，用于自主空间导航。

TLDR: This paper proposes a lightweight method for predicting rover vibrations from LiDAR point clouds and IMU feedback, enabling vibration-aware traversability mapping for autonomous space navigation.

Abstract: Autonomous navigation in space requires reliable terrain assessment for safe operations, especially in underground environments with limited communication, computing resources, and power budget. This paper presents a lightweight method for real-time vibration-aware traversability mapping using a Light Detecting And Ranging (LiDAR) point cloud and Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) measurements. An initial vibration proxy is estimated from terrain geometry by applying Random sample consensus (RANSAC) to local point-cloud patches produced by a Simultaneous Localisation And Mapping (SLAM) algorithm. In parallel, the IMU provides local observations of the vibration experienced by the rover during traversal. The point-cloud-based prediction is then corrected online using Recursive Least Squares, allowing the system to adapt the geometric estimate to the measured rover response. The approach is evaluated in a lunar analogue environment, an outdoor field, and an underground mine.

摘要（中文）：空间自主导航需要可靠的地形评估以确保安全运行，尤其在通信、计算资源和电力预算受限的地下环境中。本文提出了一种轻量化方法，利用激光雷达点云与惯性测量单元（IMU）数据，实现实时振动感知的可通行性地图构建。通过将随机采样一致性（RANSAC）算法应用于同步定位与地图构建（SLAM）算法生成的局部点云块，可从地形几何特征中初步估算振动代理参数。同时，IMU提供巡视器行进过程中所经历振动的局部观测值。基于点云的预测结果随后通过递归最小二乘法实现在线校正，使系统能够根据实测的巡视器响应自适应调整几何估算。该方法在月球模拟环境、室外场地及地下矿场中进行了评估。

Authors: Gabriel Manuel Garcia, Stephanie Aravecchia, Miguel Angel Olivares-Mendez

Understanding Autonomous Driving Datasets by Describing Differences between Image Subsets in Natural Language AutonomousDriving

set difference captioning autonomous driving datasets object-centric patches domain shift AD-Diff Bench

简要说明：本文针对自动驾驶数据集提出集合差异描述方法，通过自然语言描述图像子集之间的差异，帮助分析数据集分布偏移并支持人工可解释的数据集检查。

TLDR: This paper introduces set difference captioning for autonomous driving datasets, producing natural-language descriptions of differences between image subsets to aid dataset introspection and address domain shift.

Abstract: Understanding the composition of large-scale autonomous driving datasets is essential for safety, robustness, and reliable operation across domains. For example, domain shift between locations could lead to the operating environment being misaligned with the training data, resulting in potentially dangerous performance degradation. Yet, existing data analysis pipelines largely rely on metadata, predefined labels, or manual inspection, which provide limited semantic insight or do not scale. This paper studies set difference captioning: given two subsets of images, the goal is to produce a natural-language hypothesis describing differences between the target and reference set. Building on a two-stage formulation, we adapt the method to autonomous driving by focusing on object-centric patches derived from object detection, which simplifies aggregation and enables attribution of differences to specific object instances or categories. To evaluate this setting in-domain, we introduce a new benchmark, AD-Diff Bench. Low-concentration experiments assess the suitability of set-difference-captioning approaches to sparse, real-world differences. We restrict our experiments to open-weight models to support reproducibility and ease of deployment. The proposed benchmark and analysis provide a step towards practical, human-interpretable dataset introspection for autonomous driving datasets. Our implementation and benchmark dataset are available at https://github.com/KIT-MRT/AD-Diff

摘要（中文）：理解大规模自动驾驶数据集的构成对于确保跨领域的安全性、鲁棒性和可靠运行至关重要。例如，不同地点之间的域偏移可能导致运行环境与训练数据不匹配，从而引发潜在危险的性能下降。然而，现有的数据分析流程主要依赖元数据、预定义标签或人工检查，这些方法提供的语义洞察有限或缺乏可扩展性。本文研究集合差异描述任务：给定两个图像子集，目标是生成自然语言假设，描述目标集与参考集之间的差异。基于两阶段框架，我们通过聚焦源自目标检测的以对象为中心的补丁，将该方法适配至自动驾驶领域，从而简化聚合过程，并能够将差异归因于特定对象实例或类别。为在领域内评估该设置，我们引入了一个新基准——AD-Diff Bench。低浓度实验用于检验集合差异描述方法在稀疏、真实世界差异场景中的适用性。我们将实验限制在开放权重模型上，以支持可复现性和易于部署。所提出的基准和分析为自动驾驶数据集提供了一种迈向实用化、可人工解读的自我审视方案。我们的实现代码和基准数据集已开源至 https://github.com/KIT-MRT/AD-Diff。

Authors: Julian Truetsch, Felix Hauser, Christoph Stiller, Frank Bieder

FailBench: How Reliable are VLMs at Judging Robot Task Success? VLA

failure detection benchmark vision-language models robot manipulation cross-domain generalization

简要说明：FailBench 是一个用于评估基于 VLM 的机器人故障检测的基准，结果表明通用 VLM 优于微调模型，且性能因任务类型而异。

TLDR: FailBench is a benchmark for evaluating VLM-based robot failure detection, revealing that general-purpose VLMs outperform fine-tuned models and that performance varies by task type.

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly used to evaluate robot manipulation outcomes, but existing benchmarks offer limited evidence of cross-domain generalization. We introduce FailBench, a benchmark for robot failure detection comprising 2,197 manipulation attempts across 14 public sources (12 real-world, 2 simulated). In FailBench, 75% of failures occur naturally, and six real-world sources come from non-failure-detection datasets. Evaluating 13 VLM-based detectors, we find the best model achieves only 0.77 mean balanced accuracy. Notably, models fine-tuned for failure detection consistently underperform general-purpose VLMs and their own pretrained baselines. Performance depends heavily on required visual evidence: models approach saturation when outcomes depend on observable object motion, but degrade to near-chance (<0.60 balanced accuracy) on contact-intensive assembly tasks. Error analysis reveals a systematic bias toward predicting success under ambiguous evidence, which persists even with increased reasoning effort. Finally, we show that input-level intervention--spatially localizing and cropping outcome-relevant regions--improves the top detector by 2.4 percentage points without extra training.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言模型（VLM）正越来越多地被用于评估机器人操作结果，但现有基准在跨领域泛化方面提供的证据有限。我们提出FailBench——一个机器人故障检测基准，涵盖来自14个公开数据源（12个真实世界数据源、2个仿真数据源）的2,197次操作尝试。在FailBench中，75%的故障自然发生，且六个真实世界数据源来自非故障检测数据集。通过评估13种基于VLM的检测器，我们发现最佳模型仅达到0.77的平均平衡准确率。值得注意的是，专门针对故障检测进行微调的模型始终逊色于通用VLM及其自身的预训练基线。模型性能高度依赖于所需的视觉证据：当结果取决于可观测的物体运动时，模型表现接近饱和；而在接触密集型装配任务中，模型性能退化至接近随机水平（平衡准确率低于0.60）。错误分析揭示了模型在模糊证据条件下存在系统性偏向于预测成功的倾向，即便增加推理努力，该偏差依然存在。最后，我们表明输入层干预——对结果相关区域进行空间定位和裁剪——可使最优检测器提升2.4个百分点，且无需额外训练。

Authors: Zaruhi Navasardyan, Tatul Danielyan, Hrant Davtyan

ARTiS: An Adaptive Robotic Gripper for Enhanced Tool Manipulation in Disassembly Applications Manipulation

adaptive gripper soft gripper dexterous manipulation fin-ray adaptation active jamming

简要说明：ARTiS 是一种新型软-硬混合夹爪，结合了基于颗粒阻塞的掌心、鳍条指尖和七自由度设计，可在拆卸任务中实现安全且灵巧的工具操控。

TLDR: ARTiS is a novel soft-rigid hybrid gripper that combines a jamming-based palm and fin-ray fingertips with seven degrees of freedom for secure and dexterous tool manipulation in disassembly tasks.

Abstract: Grasping and holding tools while using them presents a considerable challenge not only for robots but also for humans. Such a challenge is particularly noticeable in processes involving assembly and disassembly, where efficiency and consistency depend on performing rapidly adaptive tasks. Nonetheless, contemporary robotic grasping technologies that can securely manipulate tools during operation frequently have significant constraints. In this paper, introduce ARTiS (Adaptive Robotic Tool Gripper in Disassembly Systems), a novel gripper that combines the adaptability of soft grippers, the dexterity of anthropomorphic hands, and the robustness of rigid mechanisms with a soft palm and fingertips. This unique combination makes it possible to hold tools securely in a variety of situations through using active jamming in the palm and fin-ray adaptation in fingertips. Furthermore, high finger dexterity is achieved through the seven degrees of freedom design, which enables the fingertips to orient to any surface, both for automated solutions and collaborative tasks. A comprehensive evaluation was conducted using a range of conventional disassembly tools to assess the gripper's compliance, durability, and functional versatility. More information, hardware instructions, and videos at https://romanmykhailyshyn.github.io/artis/

摘要（中文）：在使用工具时抓取并握持工具对机器人和人类而言均是一项重大挑战。这种挑战在涉及装配与拆卸的流程中尤为明显——此类流程的效率与一致性高度依赖快速自适应任务的执行能力。然而，当前能在操作过程中安全操控工具的机器人抓取技术通常存在显著局限性。本文提出ARTiS（自适应拆卸系统机器人工具夹持器），这是一种创新夹持器，融合了软体夹持器的自适应性、拟人手的灵巧性以及刚性机构的鲁棒性，并采用软体手掌与指尖设计。这种独特组合通过手掌主动夹紧机制与指尖鳍状结构自适应，使其能够在多种情境下安全握持工具。此外，七自由度设计赋予手指高度灵巧性，使指尖可朝向任意表面，既适用于自动化解决方案也适用于协作任务。我们使用一系列常规拆卸工具进行了全面评估，测试了夹持器的顺应性、耐久性与功能通用性。更多信息、硬件指南及视频请访问：https://romanmykhailyshyn.github.io/artis/
