Authors: Roman Mykhailyshyn, Domae Yukiyasu, Harada Kensuke

Real-Time Shape Control of Multi-Segment Soft Robotic Arms Using Koopman Operators with Global and Local Observables Manipulation

Koopman operators model predictive control shape control soft robotic arms real-time control

简要说明：基于Koopman算子和全局与局部观测量的模型预测控制框架实现了多段软体机械臂的实时形状控制，在仿真中最多控制10个段，并在3段和5段硬件上验证。

TLDR: A Koopman-based MPC framework with global and local observables enables real-time shape control of multi-segment soft robotic arms, demonstrated on up to 10 segments in simulation and 3- and 5-segment hardware.

Abstract: Multi-segment soft robotic arms can continuously reconfigure their body shapes for safe interaction, but tip control alone is insufficient for constrained-space tasks. Therefore, shape control is a more important task for multi-segment soft arms than tip control, but remains challenging due to the high dimensionality and nonlinear dynamics of continuum deformation. In existing work, shape control accuracy is defined by the error in the global frame (global shape error). For multi-segment soft arms, using only global shape error as the control objective is insufficient, as segment coupling, gravity-induced loading, and inertial effects become more significant. This difficulty increases with the number of segments. In this paper, we present a Koopman-based model predictive control framework that combines global and local observables, enabling real-time shape control on multi-segment soft robotic arms. The framework is evaluated through numerical and physical experiments. Numerical experiments demonstrate the scalability of the proposed controller by achieving shape control on robots with up to 10 independently actuated segments. The physical experiments demonstrate that the controller is capable of (1) real-time shape control of 3- and 5-segment robotic arms with tip speeds up to 0.6 m/s, (2) robust tracking without retraining, including distal payloads up to 400~g and recovery from a 7~N lateral disturbance, and (3) the potential for future inspection applications through a confined-space demonstration. These results demonstrate that the proposed framework enables dynamic, scalable, and accurate real-time shape control on multi-segment soft robotic arms.

摘要（中文）：多段软体机器人臂可通过连续重构其形态实现安全交互，但仅依赖末端控制不足以应对受限空间任务。因此，相较于末端控制，形态控制对多段软体臂更为关键，然而由于连续体变形的高维度与非线性动力学特性，该任务仍具有挑战性。现有研究中，形态控制精度由全局坐标系下的误差（全局形态误差）定义。对于多段软体臂，仅以全局形态误差作为控制目标并不充分——段间耦合、重力载荷及惯性效应的影响会更为显著，且该难度随段数增加而加剧。本文提出了一种基于Koopman的模型预测控制框架，通过融合全局与局部可观测变量，实现了多段软体机器人臂的实时形态控制。数值与物理实验对该框架进行了评估：数值实验验证了控制器对多达10个独立驱动段机器人的可扩展性；物理实验证明该控制器能够：(1) 实现3段与5段机器人臂在末端速度达0.6米/秒时的实时形态控制；(2) 无需重新训练即可实现鲁棒跟踪，包括承受高达400克远端负载及从7牛顿侧向扰动中恢复；(3) 通过受限空间演示揭示其在未来检测应用中的潜力。结果表明，所提框架能够实现多段软体机器人臂的动态、可扩展且精确的实时形态控制。

Authors: Jiahe Wang, Eron Ristich, Sultan Haidar Ali, Eric weissman, Lei Zhang, Wanxin Jin, Yi Ren, Jiefeng Sun

Seeing Less Is Not Seeing Safely: Privacy Leakage from Task-Scoped Robot Perception Exports VLN

task-scoped representation privacy leakage perception distillation embodied navigation AI2-THOR

简要说明：本文揭示了家用机器人结构化感知导出中的隐私泄露风险，并提出了任务限定感知蒸馏（TFPD）框架；在导航、碰撞检测和目标执行任务上的实验表明，任务等价下隐私不等价现象显著，需进行任务特定的多风险评估。

TLDR: This paper identifies privacy leakage risks in structured perception exports from domestic robots and proposes TFPD, a task-scoped representation-export framework; experiments on navigation, collision checking, and object-goal execution show task-equivalence with stark privacy inequivalence, motivating task-specific multi-risk evaluation.

Abstract: Domestic robots rely on rich perception to operate in private homes, but privacy risk persists even when raw sensor data remain local. Structured representations exported to downstream planners, cloud services, logs, or learning pipelines can still reveal household information through semantics, geometry, spatial structure, and task targets. We introduce Task-Functional Perception Distillation (TFPD), a task-scoped representation-export framework that keeps rich perception local and profiles downstream exports according to task utility, direct exposure, and multiple residual inference risks. Using 120 AI2-THOR scenes with scene-disjoint train/validation/test splits, frozen attacker selection, and representation-aware held-out attacks, we evaluate navigation, collision checking, and object-goal execution. Three navigation exports achieve identical success (1.000) and mean path ratio (0.898), yet representation-level linkability ranges from 0.532 to 0.970. Replacing an explicit target label with a target region reduces target-category macro-F1 from 1.000 to 0.077 while preserving success at 0.995, while geometric coarsening reduces object-category macro-F1 from 0.704 to 0.556 at a measurable collision-utility cost. A ProcTHOR replication preserves the navigation task-equivalence/privacy-inequivalence finding while changing the relative ordering of normalized and topological exports. These results show that neither field removal nor stronger abstraction induces a universal privacy ordering and motivate task-specific, multi-risk evaluation of the complete public representation.

摘要（中文）：摘要：家用机器人依赖丰富的感知能力在私人住宅中运行，但即使原始传感器数据保留在本地，隐私风险依然存在。导出至下游规划器、云服务、日志或学习流程的结构化表示，仍可能通过语义、几何、空间结构和任务目标泄露家庭信息。我们提出任务功能感知蒸馏（TFPD），一种任务范围内的表示导出框架，它保持丰富的本地感知能力，并根据任务效用、直接暴露以及多种残余推断风险对下游导出内容进行配置。利用包含场景不重叠的训练/验证/测试划分的120个AI2-THOR场景、冻结的攻击者选择以及具有表示感知能力的预留攻击，我们评估了导航、碰撞检测和目标物体执行三项任务。三种导航导出实现了相同的成功率（1.000）和平均路径比（0.898），但表示级别的可链接性范围从0.532到0.970。将显式目标标签替换为目标区域，使目标类别宏F1分数从1.000降至0.077，同时保持0.995的成功率；而几何粗化在可量化的碰撞效用代价下，将物体类别宏F1分数从0.704降至0.556。ProcTHOR的复现实验保留了导航任务等价性与隐私不等价性的发现，同时改变了归一化导出与拓扑导出的相对排序。这些结果表明，无论是移除字段还是更强的抽象，都无法产生通用的隐私排序，从而推动了对完整公共表示进行任务特定、多风险评估的必要性。

Authors: Yuqiao Xu, Erman Ayday

WorldReward: Reward Modeling for Camera-Conditioned World Models WorldModel

reward model vision-language model world model action-consistency evaluation preference dataset

简要说明：WorldReward 是一种基于 VLM 的成对偏好奖励模型，统一了相机条件世界模型的行动一致性和视觉质量评估，提升了奖励模型与人类偏好的一致性，并通过 RL 后训练改善了行动执行和视觉质量。

TLDR: WorldReward is a VLM-based pairwise preference reward model that unifies action-consistency and visual-quality evaluation for camera-conditioned world models, improving reward-model agreement with human preferences and enabling RL post-training to enhance both action execution and visual quality.

Abstract: Camera-conditioned world models generate interactive videos in which commanded actions should induce the expected scene changes while appearance, geometry, and temporal dynamics remain coherent. Existing rewards assess these requirements separately: geometry-based rewards estimate trajectory execution but cannot judge the visual quality of the executed motion, whereas image-based rewards measure frame quality without capturing action execution or temporal dynamics. We posit that a vision-language model (VLM) offers a shared reasoning space for relating actions to their visual outcomes. However, judging a complete long video against its full action sequence creates a lengthy, noisy context in which short-lived local action evidence can be missed or diluted. We present WorldReward, a VLM-based pairwise preference reward model that unifies action-consistency and visual-quality evaluation for camera-conditioned world models. WorldReward decomposes paired videos into action-aligned chunks, organizes each chunk into structured visual evidence, and aggregates chunk-level decisions by voting into separate video-level action and visual-quality preferences. To train it, we construct a large-scale reasoning-augmented preference dataset using structured judgments generated by a frontier VLM and refined through tool-based agent auditing and targeted human review. We further introduce WorldReward-Bench, a human-annotated benchmark measuring reward-model agreement with human preferences across action consistency, appearance quality, and motion quality. WorldReward achieves the highest agreement on all three dimensions, exceeding GPT-5.5 by 3.42, 1.45, and 3.56 percentage points, respectively. When used for RL post-training of HY-WorldPlay 1.5, it consistently improves both action execution and visual quality across short- to long-term horizons.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 基于相机条件的世界模型可生成交互式视频，其中指令动作应引发预期的场景变化，同时保持外观、几何及时序动态的一致性。现有奖励机制分别评估这些要求：基于几何的奖励可估计轨迹执行情况，但无法判断执行动作的视觉质量；而基于图像的奖励能衡量帧质量，却无法捕捉动作执行或时序动态。我们提出，视觉语言模型（VLM）能为关联动作与其视觉结果提供共享推理空间。然而，针对完整长视频及其全动作序列进行评判会形成冗长且嘈杂的上下文，使得短暂的局部动作证据被忽略或稀释。为此，我们提出WorldReward——一种基于VLM的成对偏好奖励模型，可统一评估相机条件世界模型中的动作一致性与视觉质量。WorldReward将成对视频分解为与动作对齐的片段，将每个片段组织为结构化视觉证据，并通过投票将片段级决策聚合为独立的视频级动作与视觉质量偏好。为训练该模型，我们利用前沿VLM生成的结构化判断构建大规模推理增强偏好数据集，并通过基于工具的智能体审核与针对性人工审查进行优化。我们进一步引入WorldReward-Bench——一个人工标注基准，用于衡量奖励模型在动作一致性、外观质量及运动质量三个维度上与人类偏好的一致性。WorldReward在所有三个维度上均取得最高一致性，分别超过GPT-5.5达3.42、1.45及3.56个百分点。当用于HY-WorldPlay 1.5的强化学习后训练时，其在短至长期范围内持续提升动作执行与视觉质量。

Authors: Yibin Wang, Zehan Wang, Junshu Tang, Zhimin Li, Yujie Zhou, Jiazi Bu, Pengyang Ling, Feng Han, Zhixiong Zhang, Long Xing, Shengyuan Ding, Ziang Li, Cheng Jin, Yuhang Zang, Jiaqi Wang, Tianyu Pang

VeriPhy: Agentic Physical Reasoning for World Model Evaluation and Refinement WorldModel

physical-verification world model evaluation provenance typed physical obligations generation failure localization

简要说明：VeriPhy 是一个可审计的物理验证系统，它将文本提示转换为类型化的物理义务，并生成带有来源的证据，以检测和定位视频生成中的失败，支持事后分析和向世界模型提供反馈。

TLDR: VeriPhy is an auditable physical-verification system that converts text prompts into typed physical obligations and produces provenance-carrying evidence to detect and localize generation failures in video, enabling post-hoc analysis and feedback for world models.

Abstract: Visual fluency in generated video does not imply physical reliability, and a scalar quality score alone is incapable of indicating the obligation a clip violates or the moment it fails. We present VeriPhy, an auditable physical-verification system in which a text-only planner compiles the prompt into typed physical obligations and a statically validated execution plan before any frame is observed. During execution, observations gate and scope only declared calls to frozen low-level experts (e.g., segmentation and tracking, counting, eleven typed physical measurements over the resulting tracks, depth, OCR, and audio-event detection). Each action returns a provenance-carrying evidence record whose payload, when usable, is either a typed measurement or an explicitly tagged learned state. Typed resolvers and fixed composition map usable records to a three-valued state (supported, contradicted, or unknown, surfaced as plausible, implausible, or abstain) with full provenance, so that every verdict is traceable to the evidence that produced it. We anchor evaluation in a 1,500-clip corpus of human-annotated flaw records that localize real generation failures in prompt reference, space, and time. On a 149-clip core carrying 304 such records, VeriPhy accounts for 228, against 164 for a published question-decomposition evaluator given the same clips and the same claims. Recall alone does not separate it from prompting the same backbone monolithically, which reaches 222; what separates them is that each decision retains its evidence record and provenance, making the traces auditable one verdict at a time and usable as the interface through which a critic verdict could be written back into generation.

摘要（中文）：生成的视频在视觉流畅性上并不代表物理可靠性，仅凭标量质量评分无法指示视频片段违背的物理约束或失效时刻。我们提出VeriPhy——一个可审计的物理验证系统，其中纯文本规划器在观测任何帧之前，会将提示词编译为类型化的物理约束和经静态验证的执行计划。在执行过程中，观测仅触发并限定对冻结底层专家模块的声明调用（包括分割与跟踪、计数、对生成轨迹执行的11种类型化物理测量、深度估计、OCR及音频事件检测）。每个动作返回携带溯源链的证据记录，其有效载荷在可用状态下，要么是类型化测量值，要么是显式标记的学习状态。类型化解算器与固定组合规则将可用记录映射为三值状态（支持、矛盾或未知，分别呈现为合理、不合理或弃权），并附带完整溯源信息，使每个判定结果均可追溯至产生该结果的证据。我们在包含1500个视频片段的带人工标注缺陷记录语料库中进行评估，这些记录从提示词关联性、空间和时间维度定位真实的生成故障。在包含304条此类记录的149个视频核心集上，VeriPhy成功处理228条记录，而基于相同视频片段和声明条件的现有问题分解评估器仅处理164条。仅凭召回率指标无法将本系统与统一调用同一骨干模型的方法区分（后者达222条），其本质区别在于：每个决策均保留证据记录与溯源链，使追踪过程可逐条审计，并可作为将批评性判定结果回写入生成过程的接口。

Authors: Wenzhuo Xu, Yuchen Zhu, Chongjian Ge, Xuan Shen, Jing Shi, Jason Kuen, Yongxin Chen, Molei Tao, Christopher McComb, Noelia Grande Gutiérrez, Jiuxiang Gu

QLAUN: A Research-Oriented, Robust, Agile, Modular, and Affordable Torque-Controlled Quadruped Robot Locomotion

torque-controlled quadruped 3D-printed QDD actuator modular leg design legged robot locomotion

简要说明：本文介绍了QLAUN，一种低成本、3D打印的扭矩控制四足机器人，采用模块化、无电子元件的腿部设计，旨在促进学术机构中的腿式运动研究。

TLDR: This paper presents QLAUN, a low-cost, 3D-printed torque-controlled quadruped robot with a modular, electronics-free leg design, intended to facilitate legged locomotion research in academic settings.

Abstract: QLAUN Bot (Quad-Legged Adaptive Unmanned Navigator Robot) is a torque-controlled quadruped robot that is research-oriented, cost-effective, and aimed at achieving simultaneous robustness and agility while being completely 3D-printed. It is a quadruped robot that is aimed at empowering robotics research at universities and research institutes in Lebanon and the MENA region. Using a novel electronics-free leg design strategy, we present a modular robot with interchangeable and easily replaceable legs. The 15 kg robot possesses 12 DoF (Degrees-of-Freedom) with three per leg, each paired with a completely 3D-printed Quasi-Direct Drive (QDD) actuator that consists of a brushless DC motor and a low-ratio gearbox transmission that is connected to a belt transmission system for significantly increasing the torque outputs at the joints. We present legs that have decoupled hip and knee actuators to improve the overall modularity of the robot. QLAUN is almost completely 3D-printed using polylactic acid (PLA) and assembled using off-the-shelf parts to create a robust, agile, and affordable robot for legged robot locomotion research. The legs possess joints with wide ranges of motion, including a continuous hip flexion-extension joint. A compliant foot, printed using TPU-95A is also implemented for alleviating hard impacts and handling terrain uncertainties. This extended abstract aims to introduce QLAUN, a novel platform for robotics research, emphasizing the design concepts and principles that underpin its development to the academic and research communities in the field of robotics.

摘要（中文）：QLAUN Bot（四足自适应无人导航机器人）是一种面向研究、经济高效且完全采用3D打印的扭矩控制四足机器人，旨在兼顾鲁棒性与敏捷性。该机器人专为黎巴嫩及中东与北非地区大学和研究机构的机器人学研究提供支持。通过采用一种新型无电子元件的腿部设计策略，我们提出了一种模块化机器人，其腿部可互换且易于更换。这台重15千克的机器人拥有12个自由度（DoF），每条腿3个自由度，每个自由度均配备全3D打印准直驱执行器，该执行器由无刷直流电机与低减速比齿轮箱构成，并通过皮带传动系统连接，以显著提升关节扭矩输出。我们设计了髋关节与膝关节执行器解耦的腿部结构，以提高机器人整体模块化程度。QLAUN几乎完全采用聚乳酸（PLA）通过3D打印制成，并利用市售零部件组装，打造出一款坚固、敏捷且经济实惠的足式机器人运动研究平台。其腿部关节具有广泛运动范围，包括连续髋关节屈伸关节。同时采用TPU-95A材料打印的柔性足部，用于缓解硬冲击并应对地形不确定性。本扩展摘要旨在介绍QLAUN这一机器人学研究的新型平台，重点阐述支撑其开发的设计概念与原理，以供机器人学领域的学术界及研究界参考。

Authors: Mohamad S. Moudallal, Noel J. Maalouf

Programming and execution of skill-based human-robot-crane collaborative tasks Manipulation

robot skills Behavior Tree human-robot collaboration CAD-model based programming skill monitor

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于CAD模型的参数化机器人技能编程与执行系统，采用改进的行为树结构，并通过人-机器人-起重机协作任务演示了重物插入操作。

TLDR: This paper presents a CAD-model-based programming and execution system for parametrized robot skills and skill monitors using a modified Behavior Tree, demonstrated on a human-robot-crane collaborative task for inserting a heavy object.

Abstract: Highly varying production sets increasing challenges for robotic manufacturing and indoor logistics. New capabilities for agility, flexibility, and robustness are needed. Robot skills, integrating motions, tool operations, and sensor perceptions consistently provide an execution mechanism for a versatile set of tasks with varying parameters. In this paper, easy-to-use CAD-model based programming and execution system for parametrized skills and skill monitors is showcased. The execution control structure is dynamic and parametrized, based on a modified Behavior Tree, where only event based communication is used. A human-robot-crane collaborative skill is shown as a test example, where a human instructs an overhead crane and a manipulator in inserting a heavy object supported by the crane, and guided by the manipulator, into the goal.

摘要（中文）：多变的生产场景为机器人制造与室内物流带来了日益严峻的挑战，亟需具备敏捷性、灵活性与鲁棒性的新型能力。机器人技能通过整合运动、工具操作与传感器感知，为参数可变的多样化任务提供了一套统一的执行机制。本文展示了一种基于CAD模型的易用编程与执行系统，支持参数化技能及技能监控器的应用。其执行控制结构基于改进型行为树实现动态参数化，仅采用基于事件的通信方式。以人机桁车协作技能作为测试案例：操作员通过指令控制桥式起重机与机械臂协同作业，将起重机悬吊的重型工件在机械臂引导下精确插入目标位置。
